abstract: Generative AI can be a powerful tool for supporting the design and implementation of quantum applications, whereas the burden of checking whether generated circuits realize the intended computation increases. In this study, we regard this burden of human understanding, checking, and judgment as ``trust cost,'' and propose a development methodology that integrates AI and formal verification to reduce it. In the proposed development methodology, the implementation is divided into three components: a target mathematical specification, a quantum circuit, and a correspondence theorem and its proof that prove the agreement between the two. This division separates the specifications and theorem statements checked by humans from the theorem proofs entrusted to mechanical checking. As a concrete development example of this proposal, we describe an implementation for the time evolution of a stochastic particle system and its results.
summary:
1. 该工作针对生成式人工智能辅助量子应用开发中人工校验负担加重的问题，将理解、检查与判断的负担定义为“信任成本”，并提出一种融合人工智能与形式化验证的开发方法以减少该成本。
2. 其核心在于将实现拆分为目标数学规范、量子线路以及证明二者一致的对应定理及其证明，从而把人类需检查的规范与定理陈述同交由机械验证的定理证明分离开来。
3. 作者以随机粒子系统时间演化的量子实现为例展示该流程，表明将形式化验证嵌入人工智能辅助开发可在保持人类可控性的同时降低信任成本，为量子程序设计提供可扩展的验证路径。

title: Clifford Invariants and Three-Copy Quantum Tests
abstract: We give an explicit treatment of the third tensor power of the Clifford representation on $n$ qutrits, for $n\geq2$. This representation has five pairwise inequivalent irreducible constituents, with multiplicities $1,1,1,1,2$. The decomposition reduces the Clifford twirl of a tensor cube to four real parameters. Two of them are spectral moments of the input. The other two are cubic invariants expressed as sums of cubes of the Weyl characteristic function and the discrete Wigner function. On trace-one Hermitian matrices, the invariant polynomials of degree at most three are spanned by the constant function and four algebraically independent functions. These functions do not separate Clifford orbits. For pure inputs a single parameter suffices. We recover its range and the characterization of its maximum by stabilizer states. We bound the stabilizer fidelity, determine full separability across the three copies in the symmetric family, and recover the criterion for a complex projective $3$-design. We classify the jointly invariant quantum Boolean functions. For stabilizer testing and for testing unknown observables we give explicit bounds on copies and queries. We also give character formulas for the finite projective Clifford groups and record the complete character table for two qutrits.
summary:
1. 该工作显式分解 n≥2 个 qutrit 上 Clifford 表示的三次张量幂，得到五个两两不等价不可约成分，重数为 1,1,1,1,2。
2. 其核心是把对应 Clifford twirl 约化为四个实参数：两个为输入谱矩，两个为 Weyl 特征函数与离散 Wigner 函数立方和的三次不变量；迹一厄米矩阵上三次以下不变多项式由常数与四个代数无关函数张成且不分离轨道，纯态则只需一个参数。
3. 由此给出稳定子保真度界、三拷贝对称族完全可分性与复射影 3-design 判据，并导出稳定子及未知可观测量测试的副本/查询界和有限射影 Clifford 群特征标结果。

title: Classical Communication Helps Single-Shot Quantum Compression
abstract: Free classical communication can yield an unbounded single-shot saving in quantum compression, even though it leaves the asymptotic rate of an i.i.d. source unchanged. At every fixed error in $(0,1)$, we exhibit sources whose unassisted compression cost is arbitrarily large, yet a single qubit suffices with classical communication and no preshared entanglement. We establish this separation by determining the exact optimal source fidelity for compression through an $m$-dimensional noiseless quantum channel, with and without free classical communication, while preserving correlations with an inaccessible reference. Without classical assistance, the optimal fidelity is exactly the Ky Fan norm $\|\rho\|_{(m)}$, the sum of the $m$ largest eigenvalues of the source state. With classical assistance, we obtain an explicit spectral threshold formula and a protocol attaining it. Classical communication strictly improves fidelity whenever $m$ is smaller than the source rank. The corresponding compression costs are two smoothed versions of the log-rank entropy, also called max-entropy: trace-distance smoothing under local operations and quadratic smoothing under LOCC. For i.i.d. copies of a fixed source with positive entropy variance, however, the two costs have identical first-, second-, and third-order asymptotic terms. For nonlattice spectra, we determine the constant-order advantage: classical communication saves $\log_2(e)-1$ bits per block asymptotically, and the ratio of assisted to unassisted minimum communication dimensions converges to $2/e$.
summary:
1. 自由经典通信可以在量子压缩中产生无限的单次节省，尽管它留下了独立同分布的渐近率。
2. 具有正熵方差的固定源的副本，然而，两个成本具有相同的一阶、二阶和三阶渐近项。
3. 这为相关模型、算法、实验平台或后续理论研究提供了可继续推进的方向。

title: Entanglement generation from degeneracy breaking of superradiant Liouvillian steady states by local operations
abstract: Superradiance is a collective optical effect where emitters cooperatively radiate with a maximal intensity scaling proportional to the square of the number of emitters. Despite the superradiant cascade transitioning through highly entangled states, it has been shown that, for dynamics along the Dicke ladder, superradiance need not generate entanglement between the emitters. By contrast, we show how introducing incoherent local processes -- normally considered detrimental to both entanglement and superradiance -- can generate high levels of inter-emitter entanglement. We develop a general framework, using degenerate non-Hermitian perturbation theory, for the study of superradiant Liouvillian steady-state degeneracy breaking by these local operations from a few emitters up into the thermodynamic limit. From this, we are able to show that entanglement becomes ubiquitous in this regime and demonstrate its robustness against other forms of symmetric environmental noise. In the regime where pumping dominates, we find that population accumulates towards the maximally entangled minimal pseudo-spin states, corresponding to multi-emitter singlet states. This provides a deeper insight into many-body entanglement and the curious connection between local operations and entanglement generation.
summary:
1. 该工作提出用局域非相干操作打破超辐射 Liouvillian 稳态简并，并建立退化非厄米微扰理论框架，将分析从少量发射体推广至热力学极限。
2. 其核心在于表明通常被视为破坏纠缠与超辐射的局域耗散过程，反而能诱导高发射体间纠缠，且在泵浦主导时布居会积累到对应多发射体单态的最大纠缠最小赝自旋态，并对此类对称环境噪声保持稳健。
3. 这为理解多体纠缠及局域操作与纠缠产生之间的反常联系提供了新视角，并启示在耗散集体系统中利用局域操作作为纠缠资源。

title: A complete classification of operator controllability for closed three-level quantum systems driven by a single control
abstract: In this work, we study operator controllability of finite-dimensional closed quantum systems driven by a single coherent control. Two general Lie-algebraic results on controllability of such systems are proved. The first gives sufficient conditions under which controllability of the system is preserved when controlled energy-level shifts are added. The second gives a sufficient basis-element condition under which the dynamical Lie algebra contains $\mathfrak{su}(N)$ and the system is therefore operator controllable. These results, together with known controllability conditions, are applied to obtain a complete classification of operator controllability of all three-level quantum systems in terms of their free and interaction Hamiltonian matrix elements. This classification covers all combinations of energy-level and level-spacing degeneracies, two or three allowed transitions, as well as the presence or absence of controlled energy-level shifts, and gives necessary and sufficient conditions for operator controllability in each case.
summary:
1. 该工作研究由单一相干控制驱动的有限维闭合量子系统的算子可控性，证明两个李代数判据，并对全部三能级系统按自由和相互作用哈密顿量矩阵元给出算子可控性的完全分类。
2. 其技术核心是建立受控能级移动下保持可控性的充分条件，以及使动力学李代数包含 su(N) 的基元充分条件；由此覆盖能级与能隙简并、两条或三条允许跃迁及受控能级移动有无的全部组合，并给出每类可控性的充要条件。
3. 该完全分类为三能级系统的可控性判定与模型设计提供完整判据，其李代数方法也可用于分析更高维单一控制系统的可控性。

title: The Rényi area law conjecture is false below $α=1$ in high dimensions
abstract: Area laws express the expectation that entanglement in gapped quantum ground states scales with a boundary rather than a volume. In one dimension this holds for every Rényi entropy, and the Rényi area-law conjecture asserts the same in higher dimensions for each fixed $0<\alpha<1$. Here we disprove this conjecture in every spatial dimension two and higher. We construct finite-range Hamiltonians with fixed local dimension, bounded interaction strength, unique ground states and a uniform spectral gap, whose ground states exhibit volume-law Rényi entanglement while obeying a von Neumann area law and remaining connected to product states through uniformly gapped local paths. The mechanism is error-space complexity: locally identifiable components of arbitrarily small weight can encode states with high entanglement complexity. We also establish the worst-case rank-error trade-off for approximate ground-state projectors, a key tool in one-dimensional area-law proofs. At fixed gap, the optimal Schmidt rank at projection error $\epsilon$ across a planar cut of cross-section $A$ scales as $\exp[\tilde{\Theta}((A\log\epsilon^{-1})^{2/3})]$ when $\log\epsilon^{-1}\gtrsim A$. Thus $\alpha=1$ is the sharp threshold for a universal Rényi area law within this adiabatically connected class.
summary:
1. 面积定律表达了这样的期望：有隙量子基态中的纠缠与边界而不是体积成比例。
2. 因此 $\alpha=1$ 是这个绝热连通类中通用 Rényi 面积定律的尖锐阈值。
3. 这为相关模型、算法、实验平台或后续理论研究提供了可继续推进的方向。

title: Photonic realization of an electromagnetic cavity field with uniform mirror motion
abstract: We perform a detailed mathematical study of the effective Hamiltonian describing a non-stationary electromagnetic cavity field, introduced by C.~K.~Law, in the presence of uniform linear motion. We find that the corresponding dynamical equations admit a unitary diagonalization and that the normalized velocity of motion satisfies the two-sided bound $\lvert v/c \rvert \lesssim 10.1716$. Although this result is mathematically consistent, the interval obtained is an order of magnitude larger than the physically admissible range $\lvert v/c \rvert < 1$. To address this limitation, we propose a reinterpretation of bosonic coupling terms as generators of the symplectic algebra $\mathrm{Sp}(4,\mathbb{R})$, identifying them with transformations that can be implemented through linear optical elements. Within this photonic approach, the coupling parameters are not restricted to small values, allowing us to explore regimes of strong effective interactions. In this case, we demonstrate the generation of two-mode squeezed states and derive analytical expressions for the average photon number in each mode. Furthermore, we analyze statistical properties that characterize mixedness and entanglement, including intermode correlations, the Mandel parameter, and the linear entropy. The corresponding Wigner function provides a phase-space visualization of the system's behavior, illustrating the connection between cavity motion, mode coupling, and nonclassical field correlations via the underlying symplectic algebra.
summary:
1. 该工作重新审视匀速运动镜面下非稳态电磁腔场的有效哈密顿量，求得动力学方程可幺正对角化，并给出归一化速度的双边界 |v/c| ≲ 10.1716。
2. 其核心是将玻色耦合项解释为 Sp(4,R) 辛代数的生成元，并用线性光学元件实现，从而突破小耦合限制，展示双模压缩态、平均光子数解析式及模间关联、Mandel 参数、线性熵和 Wigner 函数等非经典特性。
3. 这一光子学映射表明腔体运动与模耦合可通过辛代数统一描述，为强有效相互作用下制备和探测纠缠与非经典场关联提供了可行平台。

title: Criticality Concentrates Extensive Sensing Information into a Local Readout
abstract: We show that criticality concentrates extensive sensing information into a local trajectory. In the rapid-readout limit of an all-to-all dissipative feedback network, a single binary trajectory has a Fisher-information rate linear in $N$ for a common weak field, as does the full record. Critical slowing does not remove this gain because the local weight of the slow mode decreases with $N$. An analytic bound guarantees that the local record retains more than half of the full information across the entire channel-parameter range. We also identify how parameter drives and observation dynamics determine local access to collective information beyond permutation symmetry. Furthermore, our sparse-readout theorem establishes a $k^{-1}$ decay of fractional information loss: only $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1})$ trajectories are needed to retain a fraction $1-\varepsilon$ of the full information rate. Any growing readout set, even of vanishing density, asymptotically recovers the full common-field Fisher-information rate.
summary:
1. 我们证明了临界性将广泛的传感信息集中到局部轨迹中。
2. 其卖点在于提炼出该问题中的关键机制、方法优势或可计算结构。
3. 这为相关模型、算法、实验平台或后续理论研究提供了可继续推进的方向。

title: Breakdown of thermalization in quantum spin systems with long-range interactions
abstract: Quantum thermalization of closed systems -- i.e. the relaxation of local properties to their thermodynamic value along the Hamiltonian evolution -- is generically expected in non-integrable systems at finite energy density. In this work we show that quantum spin systems with at least one spin component coupled through long-range ferromagnetic interactions, and a second spin component coupled to a field, cannot in general thermalize to a paramagnetic state whenever they have a finite, negative energy per spin. The long-range interactions we consider decay as a power law of the distance, $\sim r^{-\alpha}$ with $\alpha < d$, where $d$ is the number of spatial dimensions of the system. The lack of thermalization is generic to an infinite family of Hamiltonians, and it is not associated to any form of integrability. It can instead be understood by the anomalous features of the thermodynamics of the system in the paramagnetic phase, which cannot be reflected in the properties of the eigenstates. This leads to a breakdown of eigenstate typicality and of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis. Interestingly, the non-thermal states emerging at long times in the dynamics display long-range multipartite entanglement, elevating the breakdown of thermalization to a resource.
summary:
1. 该工作证明，在至少一个自旋分量经长程铁磁相互作用、另一分量耦合外场的量子自旋系统中，有限负自旋能量密度下一般无法热化至顺磁态。
2. 其关键在于非可积起源：α<d 的长程铁磁耦合使顺磁相热力学异常无法映射到本征态，从而破坏本征态典型性与本征态热化假设。
3. 长时动力学出现的非热态具有长程多体纠缠，表明热化破缺可转化为量子资源，并启发利用其进行量子信息任务。

title: Separability criteria and lower bounds of entanglement via realignment
abstract: The detection and quantification of quantum entanglement are central problems in quantum information science. Based on the realignment of density matrices and the vectorization of reduced density matrices, we construct a family of enhanced separability criteria for bipartite and multipartite quantum systems. Our criteria recover the previously proposed realignment-based criteria as special cases and detect more entanglement than the earlier ones. Moreover, we derive tighter lower bounds for the concurrence and the convex-roof extended negativity, criteria for detecting the genuine tripartite entanglement, and lower bounds on genuine-multipartite-entanglement concurrence. The advantages of our results are demonstrated with detailed examples.
summary:
1. 该工作基于密度矩阵重排与约化密度矩阵矢量化方法，系统构建了一族适用于两体及多体量子体系的增强可分性判据。
2. 其主要卖点在于把先前基于重排的判据作为特殊情形恢复，并能检测更多纠缠，同时给出更紧的并发度与凸顶扩展负度下界、真三体纠缠判据以及真多体纠缠并发度下界。
3. 该框架的优势通过若干具体例子展示，为量子信息任务中区分可分态与纠缠态、并定量刻画两体及多体纠缠提供了可推广且更严格的判据与下界。

title: Two-axis twisting by two-photon exchange: rate, depth, and the self-Kerr constraint
abstract: The coherent exchange of pairs of quanta between two bosonic modes is equivalent, up to a numerical factor, to the generator of two-axis twisting, which attains Heisenberg scaling of the squeezing; we determine how much of that equivalence survives in a realistic nonlinear medium. In any such medium the exchange term is accompanied by a local Kerr nonlinearity, and within a sector of fixed particle number the Hamiltonian depends on a single dimensionless ratio of the effective Kerr strength to the exchange strength. We derive two criteria governing this ratio and show that they are independent. The first is the rate at which squeezing is generated: the exponential rate follows in closed form, vanishes exactly when the two strengths are equal in magnitude, and recovers as the square root of the detuning from that point. The second is the depth to which squeezing can be driven: at fixed particle number the attainable depth is a function of the anisotropy of the mean-field saddle alone, reaches the full two-axis-twisting value only for the isotropic saddle, and is independent of the rate, parameter sets sharing the same anisotropy but differing in rate by a sizeable factor giving depths that agree to every printed digit. The closed-form Gaussian dynamics reveals a pitfall: extracting rates from short-time data overestimates them by more than a factor of two unless the saddle is isotropic. An isotropic cubic nonlinearity imposes the value of the ratio where the rate vanishes, so realizing two-axis twisting by pair exchange requires detuning it; a moderate mismatch already recovers almost all of the optimal depth. We also explain why the constraint has not surfaced before: at two quanta the self-Kerr shifts the two coupled states equally, so the two twisting Hamiltonians are rigorously indistinguishable, the degeneracy being lifted only from four quanta.
summary:
1. 两个玻色子模式之间量子对的相干交换在数值因子范围内相当于两轴扭曲的发生器，从而实现了挤压的海森堡标度；我们确定在现实的非线性介质中存在多少等价性。
2. 第二个是挤压可以达到的深度：在固定粒子数下，可达到的深度是平均场鞍的各向异性的函数，仅对于各向同性鞍达到完整的双轴扭曲值，并且与速率无关，参数集共享相同的各向异性，但速率不同，给出了与每个打印数字一致的深度。
3. 这为相关模型、算法、实验平台或后续理论研究提供了可继续推进的方向。

title: Quantum ordinal optimization under a fixed comparison budget
abstract: Ordinal optimization selects designs that are good enough rather than optimal when evaluation is expensive and the budget is small. The alignment probability measures the chance that the selected set contains at least a prescribed number of truly good designs. We formulate quantum ordinal optimization as a class of problems that maximize this probability under a fixed oracle budget. We study exact, coherent pairwise comparisons with one selected design as a first instance, with the budget counted in comparison queries. For every classical comparison budget smaller than the number of designs, we prove that a knockout among uniformly sampled designs attains the optimum. The sample is drawn without replacement and contains one more design than the number of comparisons. For a uniformly random order, the selected design's rank has a polynomial probability law. At the same comparison budget, the maximum quantum degree is at most twice the classical maximum, a factor attained whenever there are more than twice as many designs as comparisons, so a quantum algorithm can realize rank laws that no classical algorithm with the same budget can. We determine the exact quantum optimum with one comparison for every number of designs and every good-enough set. For selecting the best of n designs, the optimal success probability with one quantum comparison is approximately 3.30/n for large n, compared with 2/n for one classical comparison. When the best design is sought, one quantum comparison gives a higher alignment probability than two classical comparisons whenever there are more than nine designs.
summary:
1. 该工作将序优化建模为固定比较预算下最大化对齐概率的问题，并研究精确相干成对比较、选一个设计的首个实例。
2. 其卖点是证明经典最优由均匀抽样淘汰赛实现，量子最大度数至多翻倍且常可达，并给出一次量子比较的精确最优及约3.30/n的选最优概率。
3. 这显示量子算法可实现同预算经典无法实现的秩律，且n>9时一次量子比较的对齐概率高于两次经典比较。

title: Local-dimension-invariant low-density parity-check stabilizer codes
abstract: The protection of quantum information in systems leveraging more than two basis states (qudits) is an ongoing challenge. A tool for transforming the plethora of qubit stabilizer codes into qudit stabilizer codes is the local-dimension-invariant (LDI) extension to the stabilizer formalism. A drawback of the LDI method is that generally in order to ensure the distance of the resultant code is at least preserved the newly selected local-dimension will need to be any prime bigger than a large cutoff value. In this work we consider the repercussions of this large cutoff value, then by focusing on quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes we are able to bring down this cutoff value. Notably, we are able to reduce it in some cases to the initial local-dimension and for arbitrary CSS qubit-derived codes to singly exponential in $d$ with no dependence on the number of logicals $k$. This reduces the size of the caveat in LDI forms in their distance preservation condition.
summary:
1. 该工作针对局部维度不变稳定子编码中为保持码距通常需将新局域维度取为大于很大截断值的素数这一限制，考察其后果并聚焦量子低密度奇偶校验码以降低该截断值。
2. 其主要技术卖点在于：对量子低密度奇偶校验码可将截断值在某些情形降至初始局域维度；对任意由CSS量子比特码导出的码，则可降至码距d的单指数级且与逻辑量子比特数k无关。
3. 这削弱了局部维度不变方法距离保持条件中的关键限制，使更多量子比特稳定子码能高效推广到高维量子稳定子码，并为高维量子纠错码与量子低密度奇偶校验码设计提供更实用的路径。

title: Sequential optimization for orbital-optimized variational quantum eigensolvers
abstract: Orbital optimization within the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) framework is useful for improving active-space quality and accurately capturing electron correlation with shallow quantum circuits. The orbital-optimized unitary coupled cluster (OO-UCC) method [W. Mizukami et al., Phys. Rev. Res. 2, 033421 (2020)], in its original formulation, employs the orbital gradient and Hessian in a Newton--Laphson procedure. In this study, we propose sequential orbital-optimized unitary coupled cluster doubles (SOO-UCCD), extending the gradient-free sequential minimal optimization approach [K. M. Nakanishi et al., Phys. Rev. Res. 2, 043158 (2020)] to orbital rotation parameters. Based on the frequency structure implied by the algebraic properties of the orbital rotation generators, our method determines each orbital rotation angle from a nine-point energy profile. The energy landscape is evaluated by classically transforming the Hamiltonian integrals and contracting them with the reduced density matrices already measured for the VQE energy evaluation. This allows for orbital optimization without evaluating the orbital gradient or Hessian. By building on the core benefits of the OO-UCC framework, our method provides a gradient-free and hyperparameter-free orbital-optimization procedure. State-vector simulations for LiH in the STO-3G basis show that SOO-UCCD reproduces UCCSD-level accuracy along the bond-stretching curve and exhibits macro-iteration convergence comparable to that of L-BFGS-based orbital optimization.
summary:
1. 该工作提出序列轨道优化UCCD（SOO-UCCD），将无梯度序列最小优化推广至轨道旋转参数，以规避OO-UCC原方法中的梯度/Hessian。
2. 其卖点在于利用轨道旋转生成元的代数频率结构，由九点能量剖面确定各旋转角，无需计算轨道梯度或Hessian，并复用VQE已测的约化密度矩阵。
3. LiH/STO-3G模拟中，SOO-UCCD沿键拉伸达UCCSD精度，宏迭代收敛与L-BFGS相当，表明无梯度、无超参轨道优化可增强浅线路VQE。

title: Permanent Thermodynamic Mpemba Inversion from Quantum-Jump Feedback
abstract: We show that a common quantum-jump feedback protocol can permanently reverse the nonequilibrium free-energy ordering of two prescribed initial states while preserving their Gibbs equilibrium. The construction exploits collective compensation between monitored channels: their feedback corrections cancel at equilibrium but remain active during relaxation. This balance preserves free-energy monotonicity while allowing the relaxation modes to be reshaped. We prove that eliminating the complete slow-sector contribution of the initially higher-free-energy state, while retaining it for the comparison state, produces distinct asymptotic decay exponents. Their free-energy ratio then vanishes at long times, guaranteeing a permanent thermodynamic quantum Mpemba inversion under the same controlled dynamics. A thermal qutrit realizes the mechanism through coherence interference and exhibits distinct detection thresholds for spectral selection and exact slow-sector cancellation under feedback retuning.
summary:
1. 该工作提出基于量子跃迁反馈的方案，永久反转两指定初态的非平衡自由能排序，同时保持吉布斯平衡态不变。
2. 其卖点是利用监测通道集体补偿使反馈修正仅在弛豫期生效，消除初始高自由能态的完整慢扇区贡献、保留比较态慢扇区，从而产生不同渐近衰减指数。
3. 热三能级量子系统可通过相干干涉实现该机制，并呈现谱选择与慢扇区精确消除的不同探测阈值，为反馈调控量子姆潘巴反转提供可检验平台。

title: QIAP: A Quantum-Inspired Authentication Protocol with BB84-Based Channel Monitoring
abstract: Authentication in quantum-aware communication settings requires mechanisms that verify user legitimacy while also assessing whether the communication channel exhibits excessive disturbance. This paper presents QIAP, a stateful hybrid framework that combines classical commitment-based challenge-response authentication with BB84-based quantum-channel monitoring. QIAP uses a dual-branch verification structure inspired by rectilinear and diagonal basis selection. In the rectilinear branch, the prover opens a hash-based commitment and the verifier checks consistency with the registered round token. In the diagonal branch, the prover returns an HMAC tag bound to the verifier nonce, round identifier, and submitted commitment without disclosing the round-specific sub-secret. Under the stated hash, HMAC, freshness, secure-registration, protected-storage, and high-entropy-secret assumptions, QIAP provides computational resistance to the modeled wrong-secret and replay attempts and protects the long-term master secret from direct recovery. After successful authentication, the BB84 module estimates the quantum bit error rate (QBER) and aborts the session when the measured value reaches or exceeds the configured threshold. In the reported simulation, no successful authentication was observed among 1,000 tested wrong-secret attempts per branch. The baseline and full intercept-resend conditions produced mean QBER values of approximately 0.02 and 0.25, respectively. The classical authentication stage required approximately 0.6 ms, and the implemented authentication messages required approximately 113 bytes per round. These results indicate that QIAP can provide a lightweight hybrid framework for combining secret-based identity verification with QBER-based channel-disturbance assessment under the stated threat model.
summary:
1. 该文提出 QIAP，一个将经典承诺挑战—响应认证与 BB84 量子信道监测结合的有状态混合框架。
2. 其卖点是以直角/对角基选择构建双分支验证，并用 QBER 阈值在认证后检测信道扰动、必要时中止会话。
3. 在所述威胁模型下，1000次错误秘密尝试均无成功认证，基线/截获-重发 QBER 约 0.02/0.25，为轻量量子感知认证提供启发。

title: Bootstrapping Classical and Quantum Query Lower Bounds for Finding Tarski Fixed Points
abstract: The Tarski fixed-point problem asks for a fixed point of a monotone map on a $k$-dimensional grid lattice of width $n$ and has applications in game theory, economics, and verification. Substantial gaps remain between the known upper and lower bounds on its quantum query complexity. We prove two hardness bootstrapping theorems for quantum query lower bounds. Starting from a hard instance family whose instances have pair-wise incomparable unique fixed points, and a lower bound established by the nonnegative adversary method, we bootstrap this lower bound by (i) a factor of $\Omega(t)$ when the dimension is multiplied by $t$ and the width remains unchanged, and (ii) a factor of $\Omega(\log m)$ when the width is multiplied by $m$ and the dimension is doubled. Applying these theorems, we obtain three consequences: (i) an $\Omega(k\log^2 n)$ lower bound for $k\geq 4$, improving previously best-known classical and quantum lower bounds; (ii) for every fixed constant $\alpha>0$, there exists a constant $\delta(\alpha)>0$ such that $Q_\epsilon(\text{Tarski}(n,k))=\Omega(kn^{\delta(\alpha)})$ whenever $k>n^\alpha$, and in particular, an $\Omega(kn^{0.0072})$ lower bound for $k>n^{2/203}$, the first lower bound with simultaneous linear dependence on the dimension and polynomial dependence on the width; and (iii) a superpolynomial lower bound of $(k/\log k)^{\Omega(\log k)}$ for exponentially wide grids, where $n=2^{\Theta(k)}$. The last result rules out a route to polynomial-time algorithms for simple stochastic games and ARRIVAL through generic polynomial-query black-box Tarski solvers.
summary:
1. Tarski 不动点问题要求在宽度为 $n$ 的 $k$ 维网格上找到单调映射的不动点，并在博弈论、经济学和验证中具有应用。
2. 应用这些定理，我们得到三个结果：(i) $k\geq 4$ 的 $\Omega(k\log^2 n)$ 下界，改进了先前最著名的经典和量子下界；。
3. (iii) 指数宽网格的超多项式下界 $(k/\log k)^{\Omega(\log k)}$，其中 $n=2^{\Theta(k)}$。

title: Classical and Quantum Information Measures Characterizing Convertibility: An Axiomatic Approach
abstract: In this PhD thesis, we take an axiomatic approach to studying multivariate divergences, which are measures of the information content of a tuple of classical or quantum states. These divergences are studied in the context of large-sample and catalytic convertibility of tuples of states. This type of convertibility is characterized by the ordering of an axiomatically defined family of divergences. In this thesis, we identify this family of divergences explicitly for two scenarios, one classical and one quantum. In the classical setting, we show that the relevant divergences are certain generalizations of the bivariate Rényi divergences. Unlike previous studies, we do not require the distributions to have the same support, yielding interesting new divergences. In the quantum setting, we consider pairs of classical-quantum states with pure component states, and find that majorization is characterized by all $\alpha$-$z$ relative entropies for $\alpha<1$. This demonstrates the first operational interpretation of these relative entropies.
summary:
1. 该工作采用公理化方法研究多变量散度，用以刻画经典或量子态元组在大样本与催化可转换性下的序关系，并显式给出经典与量子两种场景对应的散度族。
2. 其技术要点在于：经典情形下相关散度为双变量Rényi散度的某些推广且不要求分布同支撑，量子情形则证明分量纯的经典-量子态对之间的优超关系由所有α<1的α-z相对熵完全刻画。
3. 该工作首次为α-z相对熵提供操作解释，表明公理化散度可统一刻画经典与量子态元组的可转换性，并启发对更一般转换场景的进一步研究。

title: Quantitative upper bounds for certain quantum channel divergences
abstract: We show that completely positive maps can be decomposed into sums of submaps which are close in completely bounded trace norm but as far apart as possible in terms of geometric channel fidelity. We then show that this kind of behavior extends to a large class of quantum channel divergences. We construct quantitative norm estimates for quantum channel divergences in terms of the Arveson-Radon-Nikodym theorem.
summary:
1. 该工作针对某些量子信道散度建立定量上界，证明完全正映射可分解为若干子映射之和，这些子映射在完全有界迹范数下彼此接近，而在几何信道保真度意义上尽可能远离。
2. 其主要技术卖点在于将上述分解行为推广到一大类量子信道散度，并借助阿弗森–拉东–尼科迪姆定理构造相应的定量范数估计。
3. 这揭示了完全有界迹范数与几何信道保真度等信道散度之间可存在显著分离，为量子信道近似、区分及相关资源理论的定量分析提供了可操作的界限框架。

title: Finite-time quantum equilibration from local correlations
abstract: An isolated quantum system evolves reversibly, yet a small subsystem can lose nearly all information about its initial state. Conserved quantities may retain some of this information, depending on how strongly they overlap with local observables. Here we consider a subsystem in an arbitrary initial state coupled to a maximally mixed bath. We show that the worst-input mean-square equilibration error, maximised over window origins, is bounded from above and below by the mean square of a complete local autocorrelation, with the stationary part subtracted. A correlation record over a finite interval therefore controls the equilibration error in every interval of the same length. The result allows arbitrary degeneracies of energies and gaps. We apply it to two static Hamiltonian families. For fixed spin subsystems in the one-particle sector of a bounded-range periodic clock, fixed-accuracy thermalisation is guaranteed on windows that grow only slightly faster than linearly with system size, despite exponentially small positive energies. A random commuting model with logarithmic interaction range retains an extensive set of conserved observables. Its expected mean-square error is bounded by a finite-size term and an inverse-time term. The inverse-time dependence is unavoidable because of the initial transient. These examples show how local relaxation can coexist with exact conservation laws and a finely spaced spectrum.
summary:
1. 孤立的量子系统可逆演化，但小型子系统可能会丢失几乎所有有关其初始状态的信息。
2. 其预期均方误差受到有限大小项和反时间项的限制。
3. 这为相关模型、算法、实验平台或后续理论研究提供了可继续推进的方向。

title: Pathfinder-BP: A Low-Latency Recursive Decoder for Topological Codes
abstract: We propose Pathfinder-BP, a recursive decoder for topological quantum codes that combines belief propagation with controlled bit-flipping. An initial BP pass identifies and permanently fixes high-confidence errors. Upon convergence failure, the decoder recursively explores alternative error patterns by tentatively flipping low-confidence variables. On surface codes, Pathfinder-BP achieves a noise threshold and logical error rate comparable to minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM). A crucial advantage of Pathfinder-BP is its highly parallelizable structure, which yields a worst-case decoding latency quasi-linear in the code distance, making it a suitable candidate for low-latency hardware implementation.
summary:
1. 该工作提出Pathfinder-BP，一种面向拓扑量子码的递归解码器，将置信传播与受控比特翻转结合，并在BP未收敛时通过试探性翻转低置信变量递归搜索替代错误模式。
2. 其核心卖点在于先用BP永久固定高置信错误，再以高度可并行结构实现最坏情况下随码距准线性增长的解码延迟，同时在表面码上达到与MWPM相当的噪声阈值和逻辑错误率。
3. 这使Pathfinder-BP成为低延迟硬件实现的可行候选，并提示可将递归搜索与并行BP结合用于其他拓扑码或实时量子纠错场景。

title: Entanglement and parametric resonance in coupled oscillator systems
abstract: We study a system of two quadratically-coupled harmonic oscillators, prepared respectively in the ground state and in a coherent state. This toy model can describe for instance the dynamics of one mode of a quantum field evolving in a harmonically-oscillating classical background. In such situations, it is well-known that, depending on the background oscillation amplitude and coupling strength, the system may exhibit parametric resonance. Using the Feynman-Vernon influence functional, we analyze the interplay between parametric resonance and quantum entanglement by perturbatively computing the purity of the mixed state resulting from tracing over one of the oscillators. We find a runaway behavior of the quantum entanglement between the two oscillators, as well as a rapid breakdown of the validity of perturbation theory, in regions of parametric instability. This provides a quantitative confirmation of various statements in the literature and is highly relevant to questions pertaining to the validity of the semiclassical approximation in coupled quantum-classical systems.
summary:
1. 该工作研究两个二次耦合谐振子分别处于基态与相干态时的动力学，并用费曼-弗农影响泛函微扰计算对其中一个求迹所得混合态的纯度，以分析参数共振与量子纠缠的相互作用。
2. 其要旨在于揭示参数不稳定区中两振子纠缠的失控增长，以及微扰论适用性的迅速崩溃，从而定量证实文献中若干相关论断。
3. 这为量子场在经典振荡背景中的演化及耦合量子-经典系统的半经典近似有效性提供了直接参考，并提示在参数共振条件下须谨慎处理微扰与半经典描述。

title: QBFF: Deep Quantum Bottleneck for Automatic Speaker Verification Anti-Spoofing
abstract: A central goal of quantum machine learning is to identify applications in which small quantum circuits can improve task performance while remaining executable on real hardware. We investigate deepfake (synthetic) speech detection, a largely unexplored application in this area, where reliable confidence scores are as important as discrimination performance because deployment decisions are made at fixed thresholds and overconfident errors can be costly. We introduce QBFF, which routes a compressed speech representation through a small 8-qubit variational circuit (VQC) used as a drop-in bottleneck, with a matched classical bottleneck as the control. The quantum circuit yields better-calibrated confidence in most matched comparisons, including out-of-distribution evaluation, though the downstream deployment-cost benefit is model-dependent. We then run the same circuit on a real IBM quantum processor. To our knowledge, this is the first anti-spoofing pipeline to run on a QPU; hardware execution demonstrates feasibility, with lower subset EER and $C_{llr}$ but higher mean actDCF than the matched classical reference. Together, these results show that hardware-executable quantum bottlenecks can improve score reliability, with gains that vary by evaluation setting.
summary:
1. 该工作提出QBFF，将压缩语音表示经由8量子比特变分电路作为即插即用瓶颈，用于自动说话人验证反欺骗，并以匹配经典瓶颈为对照。
2. 其核心卖点是在多数匹配比较与分布外评估中，量子瓶颈给出更好的置信度校准，并在真实IBM量子处理器上执行同一电路，据称是首个运行于QPU的反欺骗流水线；硬件执行在部分子集上降低EER与C_llr，但平均actDCF高于匹配经典参考。
3. 这显示硬件可执行的量子瓶颈可改善分数可靠性，但下游部署成本收益依模型而定，提示量子优势需按评估设置审慎界定。

title: Quantum state texture of maximal-resource Fourier states under Hawking radiation
abstract: Quantum state texture (QST) is a recently proposed quantum resource that characterizes the nonuniformity of a density matrix in a given computational basis. In the resource theory of QST, the Fourier states f_k are maximally resourceful states, attaining the maximum QST measure. We study the QST behavior of three maximally resourceful states in a two-mode Dirac field under Hawking radiation from a Schwarzschild black hole, using a fidelity-based measure. We consider three cases: only mode B undergoes radiation, only mode A undergoes radiation, and both modes undergo radiation simultaneously. Our results show that for single-mode radiation, if the mode unaffected by radiation is orthogonal to the single-mode textureless state, the QST of the overall output state remains maximal and is independent of the Hawking temperature; we call this phenomenon orthogonality protection. When both modes undergo radiation simultaneously, orthogonality protection vanishes, and the QST of all three Fourier states decreases with increasing Hawking temperature. Notably, the QST measure of f_3 under two-mode radiation is higher than that under only mode B radiation, indicating that QST can be redistributed among modes: QST gained by one mode under radiation can partially compensate for QST lost by the other. We further provide a general resource-theoretic explanation of orthogonality protection, showing that this phenomenon is independent of the specific form of the QST measure. These results reveal how QST degrades under Hawking radiation and provide a new perspective on the redistribution of quantum resources in black hole backgrounds.
summary:
1. 该工作在双模狄拉克场中研究史瓦西黑洞霍金辐射对三个最大资源傅里叶态 f_k 的量子态纹理（QST）影响，采用基于保真度的度量并考虑B模辐射、A模辐射和双模同时辐射三种情形。
2. 其卖点在于揭示正交保护：单模辐射下未辐射模与单模无纹理态正交时，整体输出QST保持最大且不依赖霍金温度；双模辐射使保护消失，各傅里叶态QST随温度下降，但f_3可高于仅B模辐射，显示QST可在两模间重分配。
3. 作者进一步给出与具体QST度量无关的资源理论解释，这为理解黑洞背景下量子资源的退化、补偿与重分配提供了新视角。

title: Emergent quantum algebras in dissipative time crystals
abstract: Strong dynamical symmetries provide an algebraic description of persistent oscillations in open quantum systems governed by the Lindblad equation. For finite-dimensional systems with a full-rank stationary state, such symmetries are necessary and sufficient for non-decaying oscillatory modes to appear in the Liouvillian's spectrum. These modes can be directly constructed by acting on stationary states with the identified symmetry operators. Here we establish an asymptotic counterpart of this algebra for collective spins. Taking a single spin $S$ in a magnetic field, subject to dissipation through linear jump operators, we identify the exact conditions on the field and dissipative couplings under which non-decaying oscillatory modes emerge as $S \rightarrow \infty$. We then write down a simple, closed form for the corresponding `symmetry' operator which can be applied to the steady state to construct these modes, which are eigenvectors of the Liouvillian, with imaginary eigenvalues, up to $O(1/S)$ corrections. A second operator, an emergent conserved quantity, completes the algebra, and its slow relaxation determines how quantum noise selects the stationary state. The construction can be directly extended to a pair of interacting spins sharing a common reservoir, with the resulting quantum algebra making the entanglement during a quench analytically accessible.
summary:
1. 该工作针对集体自旋在林德布拉德耗散下的持续振荡，构造了S→∞极限下的渐近量子代数，给出了非衰减振荡模出现的精确条件及对称算符闭合形式。
2. 其核心卖点在于：线性跳跃耗散与磁场满足特定条件时，刘维尔本征模可由稳态经渐近对称算符生成，虚本征值仅有O(1/S)修正，且涌现守恒量的慢弛豫决定量子噪声如何选择稳态。
3. 该构造可直接推广到共享热库的双自旋，使淬火过程中的纠缠获得解析描述，并为耗散多体系统中基于代数结构的稳态选择与时间晶体研究提供启发。

title: Closed-form construction of exceptional points in a two-parametric PT-symmetric large-matrix model
abstract: Stable bound states living on a discrete one-dimensional N-point lattice are assumed generated by a certain two-parametric PT symmetric potential $V=V(A,B)$. At any $N$, the coordinates $A=A^{(EP)}$ and $B=B^{(EP)}$ of the Kato's exceptional point (marking the phase-transition instant of the loss of stability) are defined, exactly, via roots of a certain elementary quartic polynomial.
summary:
1. 该工作在双参数 PT 对称大矩阵模型中，考察一维 N 点离散格点上由 V(A,B) 生成的稳定束缚态，并给出 Kato 例外点的闭式构造方案。
2. 其核心卖点是，对任意 N，标记稳定性丢失相变时刻的例外点坐标 A^(EP)、B^(EP) 均可精确化为某个初等四次多项式的根，从而完全避免迭代或数值搜索。
3. 这一结果将例外点求解约化为四次方程，并揭示了势参数与失稳阈值间的显式代数联系，为 PT 对称晶格及多参数非厄米系统的相变边界分析提供了可推广的解析途径。

title: Reverse quantum aging: Restoring rhythmicity from quantum aging state
abstract: Quantum aging transition has recently been reported, whereby the oscillatory dynamics of a network of globally coupled quantum self-sustained oscillators is degraded sharply when the fraction of inactive nodes exceeds a critical value. Here we explore the reverse process: the revival of rhythmic dynamics from an aged state in a quantum oscillator network by introducing a controlled incoherent single-boson pumping channel. Using a self-consistent quantum master equation in the Lindblad form for globally coupled active--inactive quantum Stuart--Landau oscillators, we show that increasing the pumping strength progressively suppresses the aging transition and eventually eliminates it, restoring rhythmicity even when all oscillators are inactive. Remarkably, complete compensation of the coupling-induced dissipative loss is not required; a substantially weaker pumping strength is sufficient to eliminate the aging transition. We show that the revival is governed by a redistribution of the Fock-state population of the inactive oscillators toward higher-occupation states. Our results establish controlled incoherent pumping as an effective mechanism for restoring dynamical robustness in quantum oscillator networks.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了如何通过引入受控的非相干单玻色子泵浦通道，从量子老化态中恢复全局耦合量子自持振荡器网络的节律动力学。
2. 其核心卖点在于：利用Lindblad型自洽量子主方程证明，即使所有振荡器均处于非活跃状态，远弱于完全补偿耦合耗散所需的泵浦强度即可消除老化转变，这一恢复源于非活跃振荡器Fock态布居向高占据态的重新分布。
3. 该结果确立了受控非相干泵浦作为恢复量子振荡器网络动力学鲁棒性的有效机制，为量子网络中的老化逆转与节律调控提供了可操作途径。

title: Euler's thirty-six officers need not all be entangled: real AME(4,6), families and classification
abstract: Absolutely maximally entangled states of four six-level systems, AME$(4,6)$, are the quantum solutions of Euler's problem of the thirty-six officers. Until recently all reported solutions were complex, and it was conjectured that no real orthogonal 2-unitary matrix of order $36$ exists. We give real AME$(4,6)$ states with $60$ non-zero coefficients in $\{\pm1,\sqrt2\}/\sqrt{72}$. Of their thirty-six officers, $12$ are classical, as some must be whenever fewer than $72$ coefficients are non-zero. They lie in the $-1$ eigenspace of an order-$4$ local symmetry, and on their support the AME conditions become linear. We derive two closed-form families of AME$(4,6)$ states that meet at one of these states: a $10$-parameter family that is supported on $72$ basis states, and an $11$-parameter family on $60$ basis states. At each of its two ends the first family loses $12$ coefficients, and the AME states on the remaining $60$ basis states form an $11$-parameter family: the second family at one end, and an analogous family at the other. These two $60$-term families contain $4096$ real AME states up to diagonal local unitaries, $1024$ of which are limits of the first family. They fall into exactly $20$ classes under local unitaries and permutations of the parties, and we certify their separation with interval arithmetic.
summary:
1. 该工作构造出实 AME(4,6) 态，即欧拉三十六军官问题的量子解，其 60 个非零系数取自 {±1,√2}/√72。
2. 其卖点在于态位于 4 阶局域对称的 -1 本征空间，使 AME 条件在支撑上线性化，并导出相交的 10 参数 72 项族与 11 参数 60 项族。
3. 这些态与分类结果（4096 个实 AME 态、20 个局域酉/置换类，区间算术认证）为实 AME 的线性构造与分类提供了明确路径。

title: The Quantum Character Transform
abstract: Bastidas et al. (2025) highlighted the importance of exploiting group symmetries to reduce computational overhead and unify simulation methods across both condensed matter physics and ab initio quantum chemistry. I discuss the discrete character transform, which is the group Fourier transform restricted to $Z(\mathbb{C}[G])$, the center of the group algebra, where class functions form a commutative convolution algebra and irreducible characters are its spectral basis. The normalized character table of a non-abelian group can be obtained through a restriction operator, which means an efficient quantum character transform for any finite group with an efficient quantum Fourier transform. I give complementary quantum algorithms for class convolution based on direct class-sum block encoding and spectral implementation in the character basis, explaining their applications to symmetry-adapted many-body dynamics, molecular and spectroscopic symmetry analysis, and quantum walks, as well as characterizing the central information used in hidden-subgroup problems, including its limitations for graph isomorphism.
summary:
1. 该工作系统讨论离散特征标变换，将其定义为限制在群代数中心 Z(C[G]) 上的群傅里叶变换，并给出有限群的高效量子实现条件。
2. 其核心卖点在于，类函数构成可交换卷积代数且不可约特征标为其谱基，归一化特征标表可由限制算子获得；因此只要有限群具备高效量子傅里叶变换，便可实现高效量子特征标变换，并给出基于类求和块编码与特征标基谱实现的互补类卷积量子算法。
3. 该框架适用于对称适配多体动力学、分子与光谱对称性分析和量子行走，并可刻画隐藏子群问题中的中心信息，同时指出其在图同构问题上的局限。

title: Geodesic steering for rapid dissipative entanglement distribution
abstract: We describe an optimal-control strategy designed to accelerate the dissipative preparation of complex, highly entangled quantum many-body states. Analogous to optimal steering of isolated quantum systems, our scheme identifies control pulses that guide the evolution of open quantum systems along trajectories of instantaneous steady states while minimizing leakage resulting from non-adiabatic transitions. In many cases of interest, these control parameters can be derived analytically and without the need for computationally expensive numerical simulations of the full many-body master equation. We apply this technique for the preparation of bi- and multipartite entangled states in qubit systems coupled to a common photonic waveguide or a distributed squeezed reservoir. In both scenarios, our optimal-control strategy significantly outperforms the bare relaxation dynamics after a quench, reducing preparation times of near-maximally entangled states by orders of magnitude. This drastic speedup makes dissipative entanglement distribution protocols compatible with high-fidelity quantum information processing applications and illustrates more broadly the potential of leakage minimization for accelerating reservoir-engineering schemes.
summary:
1. 该工作提出一种基于最优控制与测地线式操控的策略，用于加速开放量子系统中复杂高度纠缠多体态的耗散制备。
2. 其核心在于选取控制脉冲，使开放系统沿瞬时稳态轨迹演化，并最小化非绝热跃迁导致的泄漏；许多情形下控制参数可解析导出，无需数值求解完整多体主方程。
3. 在共光波导或分布式压缩库耦合的量子比特中，该策略将近最大纠缠态制备时间较淬火后裸弛豫缩短数个量级，使耗散纠缠分发更契合高保真量子信息处理，并表明泄漏最小化可广泛加速库工程方案。

title: Geomagic Square Representation of a Real AME$(4, 6)$ State
abstract: Seeking a pictorial representation of four-party absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states of local size six, we independently construct a real AME$(4,6)$ state from a table of signed Pauli matrices. Its two-unitary matrix has $60$ nonzero entries, equal to $1$ or $\pm 1/\sqrt{2}$. A locally equivalent representative yields a genuine geomagic square, where every row, column and main diagonal tiles a hexagon and all $36$ pieces are pairwise non-congruent. Colors, shapes and hatching retain the full tensor, allowing its reconstruction from the picture.
summary:
1. 该工作为四体局域维度6的绝对最大纠缠态寻找图像表示，并独立构造出一个实AME(4,6)态。
2. 其卖点是双酉矩阵仅有60个非零元，取值限于1或±1/√2，且局域等价形式给出真正的几何魔方。
3. 颜色、形状与阴影线保留完整张量信息，使该态可由图重建，为高维纠缠态的图示化表示提供了可操作范例。

title: Photon-stimulated decay of $χ$-matched ancillas causes unheralded bit flips in bosonic codes
abstract: Bosonic codes often read out their syndrome with a transmon ancilla whose computational levels $g$ and $f$ have equal parity and matched dispersive shifts: a decay $f\to e$ is then heralded and leaves the code intact, while the direct $f\to g$ is forbidden by parity. We show that the photons of the code open this decay at first order in the ancilla's decay rate. Dressing by the code mode lets the charge noise that limits the ancilla's $T_1$ drive a photon-stimulated Raman decay $|f,n\rangle\to|g,n+1\rangle$, at $(n+1)(\chi_{ge}/2g_{01})^2$ times the $f\to e$ rate for a smooth noise spectrum. When the matching is set by the detuning, the decay costs $\approx\Gamma_{fe}/\alpha$ per gate and photon, whatever the coupling strength; a deliberate mismatch or matching by a drive lowers this cost, and a qubit ancilla has no such channel. The opened decay is unheralded and flips a cat with probability $\approx 1/2$; being first order, it overtakes the second-order double decay $f\to e\to g$ as the ancilla improves. In a microscopic model of the Ocelot repetition cat code, it makes the bit-flip floor of the gates grow linearly with the cat size, by a factor 1.2-1.7 from four to ten photons, which would limit the noise bias to $\sim 10^3$. The published gate data end at four photons and do not yet test this growth.
summary:
1. 该工作揭示，玻色码用χ匹配transmon辅助比特读取综合征时，码模光子会打开原本宇称禁戒的衰减，造成未标记比特翻转。
2. 其核心机制是码模缀饰使限制辅助比特T1的电荷噪声驱动一阶光子刺激Raman衰变|f,n⟩→|g,n+1⟩，速率约为(n+1)(χ_ge/2g_01)^2倍于f→e，且在失谐匹配时每门每光子代价约Γ_fe/α、与耦合强度无关；该通道翻转猫态概率约1/2，并随辅助比特改善超过二阶双衰变。
3. 在Ocelot重复猫码微观模型中，这使门比特翻转底噪随猫码尺寸线性增长，四至十光子下增大约1.2–1.7倍，可能将噪声偏置限制在~10^3，并提示现有四光子门数据尚未检验该增长。

title: Entanglement Sudden Death in Gapped Ground States
abstract: Spatial sudden death of entanglement refers to the disappearance of quantum correlations between subsystems after a certain distance called the entanglement length. Specifically, given a density matrix $\rho_{ABC}$ on a tripartite system $ABC$ with $B$ spatially separating $A$ and $C$, the entanglement length is the distance $\ell(A,C)$ after which the reduced density matrix $\rho_{AC}$, given by tracing out the $B$ subsystem, is separable. We show in the case of gapped ground states in any dimension that the entanglement length is finite on finite subsystems. Restricting to one-dimensional systems, we prove that normal matrix product states have a finite entanglement length independent of $A$ and $C$, and that a finite pure state with such uniform entanglement length has a matrix product state representation with bond dimension independent of $A$ and $C$. Consequently, in one dimension, entanglement length distinguishes matrix product states from all other pure states.
summary:
1. 该工作研究有能隙基态中的空间纠缠突然死亡，对三分系统ABC迹出中间B后定义纠缠长度，并证明任意维度下有限子系统上的纠缠长度均为有限。
2. 在一维情形，作者进一步证明正常矩阵乘积态的纠缠长度与A、C无关且有限；反之，若纯态具有这种均匀有限纠缠长度，则其矩阵乘积态表示的键维可不依赖A、C。
3. 因此在一维中，纠缠长度可作为区分矩阵乘积态与其他所有纯态的判据，并为有能隙量子多体态的纠缠结构及张量网络表示提供新的理论视角。

title: Programmable Floquet Response for Quantum Sensing
abstract: Quantum sensing is typically based on phase accumulation and is therefore fundamentally tied to the coherence time of the sensing system. Here we introduce an alternative sensing paradigm based on programmable Floquet locking in periodically driven two-level systems. We show that periodic control generates an effective Floquet locking field whose orientation and amplitude depend on global offset, allowing information to be encoded in the driven population relaxation dynamics, not in the integrated phase. By controlling transfer between distinct Floquet locking manifolds, external perturbations can be mapped onto engineered relaxation responses whose characteristics are programmable through the driving sequence. We numerically demonstrate this approach for both DC and frequency-selective AC sensing, and show that temporal encoding of the response can provide enhanced precision in the presence of slow instrumental fluctuations. These results illustrate the potential of programmable Floquet responses and open the way to exploring new sensing strategies in driven quantum systems.
summary:
1. 该工作提出基于周期性驱动二能级系统中可编程Floquet锁定的量子传感新范式，将信息编码于驱动下的布居弛豫动力学而非累积相位。
2. 其核心在于周期控制产生有效Floquet锁定场，其方向与幅度依赖全局偏置，并通过操纵不同锁定流形间的转移把外部扰动映射为可由驱动序列编程的弛豫响应。
3. 数值上对直流与频率选择交流传感的验证表明，响应的时间编码可在慢仪器漂移下提升精度，并启发在驱动量子系统中探索规避相干时间限制的传感策略。

title: Fractional and quantum Latin squares: real solutions of quantum 36 officers problem
abstract: A Latin square can be extended by replacing its symbols with probabilities or quantum states. We relate these two extensions through explicit examples, from classical and fractional Latin squares to quantum Latin squares and a real solution of Euler's quantum 36 officers problem. A simultaneous cyclic-shift ansatz on a four-torus of tensor coefficients gives a real absolutely maximally entangled (AME) state of four six-level systems. A local orthogonal change of basis yields a representative with 96 nonzero amplitudes. Two single-party arrays obtained from the corresponding quantum orthogonal Latin square yield fractional Latin squares. Signs matter: comparison with the independent real construction of Bruzda and its sign variant distinguishes three local-unitary classes, two of which have identical probabilities. We extend this probability representation to existing seven- and nine-party AME states with six levels each. Their amplitude matrices reveal 48 complex Hadamard blocks of order $3^3$ and six of order $6^4$, respectively. These constructions separate what can be read from a probability picture from the coherent conditions responsible for maximal entanglement.
summary:
1. 该工作以显式例子关联分数拉丁方与量子拉丁方，并给出欧拉量子36军官问题的一个实数解。
2. 其卖点是用四维环面张量系数的同步循环移位拟设构造四体六能级实数AME态，局域正交基变换后仅96个非零振幅，且符号区分三个局域酉等价类。
3. 其意义在于把概率图像可读信息与最大纠缠的相干条件分开，并将概率表示推广至七体、九体六能级AME态及相应Hadamard块。

title: Moving quantum sensors
abstract: We investigate whether controlled motion of a quantum sensor offers a metrological advantage in a field-detection task. We consider a localized field of known strength $B$ occupying an unknown contiguous region making up a fraction $1/N$ of the total search space, with a qubit sensor controlled for a total time $T$ to maximize the probability of detecting the field. We study the regime in which the characteristic timescale of the field is slow compared to the time to move the sensor between any two regions, and we distinguish classical motion, where the sensor follows a definite trajectory, from quantum motion, where the sensor can be in a coherent superposition of locations. For a single classically moving sensor, we derive an optimal multi-stop protocol and obtain the exact maximum detection probability. Allowing coherent spatial superposition maps the single-sensor problem onto Hamiltonian search and reduces the interrogation time for successfully detecting the field from $\Theta(N/B)$ to $\Theta(\sqrt{N}/B)$. We then extend the problem to $M$ sensors and identify a hierarchy of optimal time scalings for constant success probability determined by the available spatial and inter-sensor quantum resources. Unentangled coherently moving sensors achieve $T=\Theta(\sqrt{N/M}/B)$ by searching disjoint regions in parallel, while entanglement among the sensors can further enhance the effective field coupling and achieve $T=\Theta(\sqrt{N}/(MB))$. Matching lower bounds establish the optimality of these scalings in the presence of arbitrary controls and ancilla systems. Our results separate the roles of classical motion, spatial coherence, and entanglement in spatial field detection.
summary:
1. 该工作研究受控运动的量子传感器在未知连续区域探测已知定域场时能否获得计量优势，并推导经典多停靠协议及多传感器最优时间标度。
2. 空间相干叠加把单传感器问题映射为哈密顿量搜索，使成功时间从 Θ(N/B) 降至 Θ(√N/B)；无纠缠并行达 Θ(√(N/M)/B)，纠缠达 Θ(√N/(MB))，匹配下界证明最优。
3. 该结果厘清经典运动、空间相干与纠缠在空间场探测中的独立作用，并为多传感器量子传感与搜索协议提供可扩展的时间标度判据。

title: Quantum Reference Frames in terms of Tetrads
abstract: We adapt to the context of quantum theory the treatment, familiar in relativity theory, of a reference frame as a tetrad. Since a tetrad is a set of four orthonormal vectors at a spacetime point, it encodes a timelike direction, three orthogonal spatial directions, and units; and so it gives a configuration in spacetime (a spatial orientation and state of motion) of an idealized infinitesimal apparatus (``rulers and a clock"). So a natural ``first guess" is that the state of a quantum reference frame should be an assignment of complex amplitudes to a set of tetrads. We develop this idea, in terms of bundles over spacetime of bases of the tangent spaces. This paper is a companion to two other papers. It emphasises the main conceptual aspects of our proposal, while the other two papers give physical details. It also explains the main contrast between those two papers. Namely: (i) the first considers a single spacetime geometry, so that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, gives a superposition of perspectives on that geometry; while (ii) the second considers the spacetime manifold with no geometry given a priori, which will imply that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, can describe a superposition of perspectives on a superposition of geometries---not ``just" a superposition of perspectives on a single geometry. The main mathematical idea for representing this contrast will be choosing between (i) the orthonormal frame bundle, for a given spacetime geometry; (ii) the frame bundle in the usual sense of containing all bases of all spacetime points' tangent spaces.
summary:
1. 该文把相对论中用四元标架刻画参考系的做法移入量子理论，提出量子参考系的状态应是对一组四元标架赋予复振幅，并以时空切空间基的丛来形式化。
2. 其核心论点在于：对给定时空几何选取正交标架丛时，量子参考系表现为同一几何上视角的叠加；而在不预设几何的通常标架丛中，它可描述几何叠加之上的视角叠加。
3. 该框架为协调量子参考系与时空几何提供了概念基础，并提示后续工作应分别处理固定几何与无先验几何两种情形，以给出具体物理细节与可检验推论。

title: Whither quantum advantage? New classical lower bounds for Max-Cut on large-girth 3-regular graphs
abstract: Every 3-regular graph of girth at least $g$ has a cut containing at least a fraction $M_g$ of its edges, and the best rigorous bounds at large girth are $0.912\le \lim_{g\to\infty}M_g \le 0.92386$. Lower bounds on $M_g$ follow from the performance of local algorithms: on a graph of girth $g \ge 2p+2$ a depth-$p$ local algorithm sees the same tree around every edge, so its expected cut fraction on that tree bounds $M_g$ from below. We apply this strategy to the Variational Iterative Rotation Algorithm (VIRAL), a classical local algorithm, and evaluate it on the depth-$p$ tree for every even depth up to $p=32$. The resulting bounds exceed those recently obtained from the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for every $p\ge 4$, by $0.005$ to $0.011$, and they extend the range of girths covered from $g=36$ to $g=66$. Notably, at $g=66$ we obtain $M_{66} \ge 0.9127$ at $99.99999\%$ confidence level, which raises the asymptotic lower bound from $0.912$ to $0.9127$.
summary:
1. 该工作用经典局域算法 VIRAL 研究大围长三正则图上的 Max-Cut，通过计算深度 p 树上的期望切割比例，给出 M_g 的新严格下界。
2. 其技术卖点是评估所有偶数深度直至 p=32，所得下界在 p≥4 时比 QAOA 高 0.005–0.011，将覆盖围长从 g=36 扩展到 g=66，并在 g=66 以 99.99999% 置信度得到 M_66≥0.9127。
3. 这将无穷围长渐近下界从 0.912 提升至 0.9127，表明经典局域算法在大围长稀疏图上可超越 QAOA，对量子优势主张构成更强挑战。

title: Quantum Cryptography and Autoformalization in Lean
abstract: Quantum key distribution provides secure communication by relying on physics principles and mathematical reasoning. Security proofs across the field can contain gaps, often between individually valid theorems integrated under mismatched assumptions. We produce an end-to-end security theorem formalized in the Lean proof assistant, eliminating hidden hypotheses by building only on Lean's standard axioms. Our proof covers composable security of the entanglement-based qubit BB84 protocol against coherent attacks by the postselection technique, accounting for finite block size, and is written in a language that enforces local operations and classical communication to help ensure a faithful representation of the protocol. The proof itself was enabled by LLM-based autoformalization, and with the proof complete, we used the same pipeline as a discovery machine, reducing the finite-size penalty on the key rate. Our work sets a reproducible standard for security arguments in quantum cryptography and shows how formal proof engines can accelerate discovery across quantum information science.
summary:
1. 该工作在Lean证明助手中对基于纠缠的量子比特BB84协议完成了端到端可组合安全性的形式化证明，覆盖相干攻击、后选择技术、有限码长，并强制局域操作与经典通信约束以忠实表示协议。
2. 其技术卖点在于仅依赖Lean标准公理、消除隐藏假设，并借助大语言模型自动形式化生成证明；证明完成后同一流程还作为发现机器，降低了密钥率的有限码长惩罚。
3. 这为量子密码安全论证建立了可复现标准，并表明形式化证明引擎能加速量子信息科学中的发现。

title: Krylov Complexity and Quantum Many-body Scars in Non-Hermitian Kinetically Constrained Models
abstract: Thermalization in closed quantum systems and its breakdown are central to understanding the emergence of statistical behavior in isolated many-body systems. Kinetic constraints can hinder thermalization by restricting the allowed dynamics and giving rise to non-ergodic behavior. While various aspects of ergodicity breaking in kinetically constrained models have been extensively studied in Hermitian systems, their behavior in non-Hermitian kinetically constrained models remains less explored. In particular, the inequivalence of left and right eigenstate ensembles in non-Hermitian systems raises the question of whether they exhibit qualitatively different dynamical and eigenstate properties. In this work, we study non-Hermitian generalizations of the paradigmatic PXP and PPXPP models, focusing on their Krylov complexity, eigenstate structure, and dynamics. By exploiting the Arnoldi's algorithm, we find distinct behavior of Krylov complexity in the left and right eigenstate ensembles as non-Hermiticity is increased: in the right ensemble, it exhibits persistent oscillations with an increasing period, while in the left ensemble, it gradually saturates. The characteristic arch-shaped profile of the Arnoldi coefficients is also modified differently in the two ensembles, with a Hermitian-like arch re-emerging in the left ensemble at large non Hermiticity. Additionally, in the non-Hermitian PXP model, the right ensemble retains the characteristic scar structure, while the left ensemble develops additional non-scar eigenstates with anomalously low entanglement and large overlap with the vacuum state. These findings reveal that non-Hermiticity can affect Krylov dynamics and eigenstate structure differently in the left and right ensembles, demonstrating the need to treat them separately when characterizing non-Hermitian kinetically constrained systems.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了非厄米动力学约束的PXP与PPXPP模型中的Krylov复杂度、本征态结构与动力学。
2. 借助Arnoldi算法，发现非厄米性增强时左右系综的Krylov复杂度行为迥异：右系综振荡周期增大，左系综趋于饱和；Arnoldi系数拱形修正不同，左系综在大非厄米性下重现类厄米拱形。
3. 非厄米PXP中右系综保留疤痕结构，左系综出现低纠缠且与真空高重叠的非疤痕态，表明需分别处理左右系综来刻画此类系统。

title: Periodic-Pulse Control of Collective Emission and Photon Statistics in Interacting Quantum Emitters
abstract: We investigate the collective emission spectra and photon correlations of two identical dipole-dipole-coupled emitters under continuous-wave (CW) and periodic pulsed driving. Our results show that a periodic train of instantaneous $\pi_x$ pulses can generate emission spectra whose dominant features closely resemble those obtained under CW excitation. We find that the structure of the collective emission spectra reflects the interplay among the resonance conditions, dipole-dipole coupling, and the inter-pulse delay $\tau_D$. We further demonstrate that finite-duration $\pi_x$ pulses with sufficiently high Rabi frequencies can closely reproduce the ideal instantaneous-pulse limit. In contrast to the emission spectra, the photon correlations $g^{(2)}(t,\tau)$ are governed primarily by $\tau_D$ and, unlike under CW driving, become increasingly insensitive to the resonance conditions in the short-pulse limit. These results establish periodic pulsed driving as a versatile means of tailoring both the emission spectra and the photon statistics of coupled two-emitter systems.
summary:
1. 该工作理论研究了两个相同偶极-偶极耦合量子发射体在连续波与周期脉冲驱动下的集体发射谱和光子关联，并比较理想瞬时π_x脉冲与有限时长脉冲的影响。
2. 其卖点在于周期脉冲序列可在主导发射谱特征上逼近连续波激发，谱结构由共振条件、偶极耦合与脉冲间隔τ_D共同决定；足够高拉比频率的有限脉冲可复现瞬时脉冲极限，而g^(2)(t,τ)主要受τ_D支配并在短脉冲极限下对共振条件不敏感。
3. 这确立了周期脉冲驱动作为调控耦合双发射体发射谱与光子统计的通用手段，并为按需设计量子光源的时域与频域特性提供明确启发。

title: A Controlled Null Result for Per-Gate Riemannian Optimization in VQE
abstract: Parametrized gates in a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) live on a product of unitary groups, which makes Riemannian optimization a natural candidate for improving training. We test this candidate in the clean per-gate setting: each single-qubit gate is optimized directly on U (2) and compared with Adam on an unconstrained Euler-angle chart representing the same physical gate, initialized from the same unitaries and tuned with a separate learning-rate sweep. On a validated hydrogen-chain benchmark, we find no measurable practical advantage from the Riemannian machinery. The direct manifold optimizer and the Euler-coordinate baseline are interleaved in final error and success rate; the classical coordinate baseline is not slower in iterations on the successful cells; and the choices of Riemannian metric, retraction, and momentum vector transport do not change the conclusion. We also identify four failure modes that can manufacture an apparent positive result: a trivial product-state benchmark, a projected-matrix Adam baseline that discards most of its own step, a non-unitary inherited Cayley retraction that lets the reported energy pass below the variational minimum, and a learning-rate grid whose optimum sits at its boundary. Each failure mode produced a plausible multi-seed result in our own workflow before being caught. The practical output of this paper is therefore a controlled null result and a validation checklist for VQE optimizer comparisons.
summary:
1. 该工作在各单量子比特门直接于U(2)上优化的清洁设定中，系统比较了逐门黎曼优化与欧拉角图卡Adam基线的VQE训练表现。
2. 在经校验的氢链基准上未发现黎曼机制带来可测实用优势，且黎曼度量、回缩与动量向量输运的选择均不改变该结论。
3. 其价值在于指出四种可制造假阳性的失效模式，并给出VQE优化器比较所需的验证清单与负结果基准。

title: A three-eighths upper bound on the stabilizer-rank exponent of face-center magic states
abstract: We give an explicit construction proving that the exact stabilizer rank of $m$ copies of the qubit face-center magic state is $O(2^{3m/8})$. Two symmetry-related fifteen-term identities combine into a twenty-four-term decomposition at twelve copies. The balanced structure of this decomposition yields a substitution that adds eight copies at a cost of eight terms per existing term. The resulting bound $\gamma_T \leq 3/8$ improves the previously published exponent $\log_2(3)/4$.
summary:
1. 该工作给出显式构造，证明 m 份量子比特面心魔态的精确稳定子秩上界为 O(2^{3m/8})。
2. 其技术核心是两个对称相关的十五项恒等式在十二份时组合成二十四项分解，平衡结构令每项增加八份仅付八项代价。
3. 该结果将 γ_T 的上界从 log₂(3)/4 改进为 3/8，并提示对称恒等式可用于构造更优的稳定子分解。

title: Chromatic Block-Gibbs p-Bit Decoding of QLDPC Codes
abstract: We introduce a parallel decoder for quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes based on probabilistic bits (p-bits), tunable stochastic binary units controlled by local fields. The idea is that predicted error configurations, interpreted as explanations of the observed syndrome, are updated stochastically using local Gibbs conditionals, while a progressively strengthened parity penalty drives the search toward syndrome-valid configurations. A coloring of the decoding graph enables parallel block updates, and independent replicas and restarts provide trajectory diversity. The best candidate encountered during the search is returned, mirroring the candidate-selection strategy of recent ensemble decoders. At the stated update budgets, the resulting logical error rates are on par with leading decoders under both code-capacity and circuit-level noise. While the total number of variable resamplings can be substantially larger than the message-update count of BP-based alternatives, the numerical results establish constraint-annealed p-bit dynamics as a competitive stochastic alternative for QLDPC decoding and motivate further study of hardware-native implementations.
summary:
1. 该工作提出一种基于概率比特p-bit的QLDPC码并行解码器，以局部Gibbs条件更新错误构型并用校验惩罚逼近有效综合征。
2. 其技术卖点在于解码图着色支持并行块更新、独立副本与重启带来轨迹多样性，并以退火校验惩罚和最佳候选选择逼近领先解码器性能。
3. 在码容量和电路级噪声下，其逻辑错误率与领先解码器相当，表明约束退火p-bit动力学是QLDPC解码的有竞争力随机方案，并启发硬件原生实现。

title: From Syndromes to Computation: A General Framework for Logical Operations in Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires error-correcting codes that not only protect quantum information but also support useful logical operations with practical physical realizations. Here we develop a general framework in which the stabilizer syndromes of commuting Pauli rotations directly organize logical-gate design. We derive an exact codespace-preservation condition valid at arbitrary rotation angles, providing a common stabilizer-level description for CSS and non-CSS codes and for both Clifford and non-Clifford operations. A particularly useful equal-syndrome specialization reduces Clifford gate design to stabilizer factorization, yields a general generator weight bound of $\lceil d/2\rceil$ for distance-$d$ codes, and systematically extends to logical rotations higher in the Clifford hierarchy. Applied to bivariate-bicycle (BB) and non-CSS Mirror qLDPC codes, the framework gives explicit low-weight Clifford and controlled-phase gates. Our implementations yield new low-weight gates, including an addressed $T$ gate on the $[[16,4,4]]$ BB code, $T$-type rotations on the $[[64,8,8]]$ BB code, and CCZ-, CS-, and $T$-type operations on the $[[36,6,6]]$ Mirror code. We also develop analytic constructions using Clifford algebra bases, which turn the syndrome constraints into explicit algebraic relations and provide a systematic route to logical addressability. We use this approach to analytically construct addressed CNOT, SWAP, controlled, and CCZ-type gates on recursive hypercube codes. An independent construction on middle quantum Reed--Muller codes yields C${}^r$Z gates that saturate the equal-syndrome weight bound. These results establish stabilizer syndromes as a constructive link between the stabilizer structure of a quantum code, the logical computations it can directly support, and the fault-tolerance properties of their physical realizations.
summary:
1. 该工作提出由对易泡利旋转的稳定子综合征直接组织逻辑门设计的通用框架，并给出任意旋转角下保持码空间的精确条件。
2. 其核心卖点是等综合征特化将克利福德门设计归约为稳定子分解，给出距离d码生成元权重上界⌈d/2⌉，并推广至克利福德层级高阶逻辑旋转。
3. 这为BB、Mirror qLDPC和递归超立方码等平台设计低权逻辑门提供系统方法，并表明稳定子综合征可连接码结构、逻辑计算与容错实现。

title: Toward Interpretable Quantum Generators for Financial Returns through Problem-Informed Circuit Design
abstract: When used as function approximators, quantum circuits often lack interpretability and face a fundamental trade-off between expressivity and trainability. We propose a problem-informed framework for financial return generation that uses relational structure and symmetry-inspired parameter sharing to guide the construction of quantum circuits with few trainable parameters and empirically testable operator roles. We evaluate three quantum generator architectures, referred to as ZZ, directed ZZ-CRX, and structured time evolution, within a hybrid Wasserstein quantum generative adversarial network trained to generate 16-step Bitcoin return windows. Across circuits with one to four layers and one to eight trainable coefficients, these generators recover meaningful marginal and temporal distributional features, while single-layer configurations remain competitive with deeper variants. Across matched depths, independently trained ZZ-CRX configurations exhibit a predominantly downward shift in median leverage relative to ZZ, consistent with the intended directional role of the controlled-rotation construction. The small number of coefficients also enables direct landscape analysis, revealing competing parameter preferences between marginal and temporal objectives and helping to explain the difficulty of finding parameter settings that perform well on both. These results provide an initial demonstration that structural assumptions can guide the design of compact quantum generators and link circuit architecture to observable statistical behaviour, motivating more systematic and parameter-efficient approaches to quantum circuit construction.
summary:
1. 该工作提出面向金融收益生成的问题导向框架，用关系结构与对称性启发参数共享来构建少参数、角色可检验的量子电路。
2. 其卖点在于三种架构在Wasserstein量子GAN中复现边际与时序特征，单层即具竞争力，且参数少使景观分析揭示边际与时序目标的竞争偏好。
3. 这一初步演示表明结构假设可指导紧凑量子生成器设计并将电路架构与统计行为关联，启发更系统且参数高效的电路构造。

title: GWPTools: An extensible Wolfram Language framework for time-dependent Gaussian wave packet dynamics
abstract: Gaussian wave packets provide an exact analytical foundation for modeling time-dependent quantum phenomena, effectively bridging the gap between classical trajectories and full quantum mechanics. We introduce GWPTools, a highly extensible Wolfram Language framework designed to compute exact time-dependent Gaussian wave packet dynamics using a unified symbolic-numeric architecture. Built upon a robust ``parameter bus'' and polymorphic dispatch, the software serves as an interactive pedagogical tool for exploring quantum theory and an exact algebraic engine for rigorously benchmarking numerical grid-based and trajectory methodologies. Version 1.0.0 focuses on exact time evolution in driven one-dimensional quadratic potentials. Native extensions into quantum hydrodynamics and phase space representations enable exact energy decompositions, analytical Bohmian trajectories, and symbolic derivations of quasi-probability distributions and information metrics. We demonstrate the framework's modular scalability by prototyping interference in superpositions, open-system decoherence, and coupled two-dimensional oscillators. Ultimately, these capabilities establish a versatile foundation for maximizing the reach of exact analytical modeling toward increasingly complex driven quantum systems.
summary:
1. 该工作提出GWPTools——一个可扩展的Wolfram Language框架，以符号-数值统一架构精确计算含时高斯波包动力学，1.0.0版聚焦一维驱动二次势中的精确演化。
2. 其核心在于“参数总线”与多态分派，并原生扩展至量子流体力学与相空间，实现精确能量分解、解析Bohm轨迹及准概率分布与信息度量的符号推导。
3. 通过叠加干涉、开放系统退相干与耦合二维振子的原型验证模块化可扩展性，为把精确解析建模推广至更复杂驱动量子系统奠定基础。

title: Representation Geometry and Inductive Biases in Quantum Classifiers across Classical Visual Benchmarks
abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has a theoretical advantage over classical algorithms for specific synthetic data that is computationally hard. However, it remains unclear whether such theoretical advantages play a meaningful role for realistic classical data, such as natural images. Quantum structural properties induced by unitary operations or entanglement introduce inductive biases that differ from those of classical models, potentially leading to distinct learning behavior on real-world data. In a fully quantum learning pipeline, classical real-world data are first encoded into quantum states via a quantum feature mapping, analogous to a classical feature extractor, and a quantum classifier then classifies the resulting states. Quantum feature mappings generate representations that are difficult to realize classically, while also inducing representation-level biases that do not necessarily match the structure of realistic data. To enable a fair comparison at the classifier level, we focus on the classifier and use classical feature extractors that already provide powerful representations for natural images. By controlling the data scale and supervision strength, we analyze how the unitary structure of quantum classifiers affects generalization, and show that their effectiveness depends strongly on the geometry of the input representations. These results indicate that quantum classifiers benefit from classical features that are aligned with quantum feature spaces. Our analysis shows that kernel alignment identifies representations compatible with quantum feature spaces, providing insights into translating classical models into quantum algorithms.
summary:
1. 该工作系统考察了量子分类器在经典视觉基准上的表示几何与归纳偏置：固定经典特征提取器，仅让量子分类器处理自然图像编码后的量子态，并控制数据规模与监督强度以比较泛化行为。
2. 核心发现是量子分类器的有效性强烈依赖输入表示几何，其酉结构与纠缠带来的归纳偏置仅在与量子特征空间对齐的经典特征上才发挥优势，而核对齐可用于识别这种兼容性。
3. 这提示将经典模型迁移到量子算法时，表示与量子特征空间的匹配比盲目引入量子结构更关键，并为在真实数据上评估量子机器学习优势提供了以表示几何为中心的判据。

title: PADO-Pauli: A GPU-Accelerated Implementation of Pauli Propagation
abstract: Variational quantum algorithms utilize parameterized circuits many times during training, at new parameter values, over batches of data, and with gradients. Pauli propagation approximates the expectation values of such circuits classically by evolving the observable in the Heisenberg picture as a truncated sum of Pauli strings. We present PADO-Pauli, a GPU engine for Pauli propagation that compiles a circuit and its observables once into sparse matrices in which each rotation angle contributes only a cosine and a sine factor, so every later evaluation reuses the compiled program. It evaluates batches of parameters and data inputs embedded as rotation angles. By default its gradients come from a vector-Jacobian product registered with PyTorch's automatic differentiation, so they flow through the angles to any classical layer that produces them. PADO-Pauli also provides truncation by Pauli weight and coefficient size, and noise channels. Zero-filtering removes terms that do not contribute to an expectation value in the all-zero reference state and makes the batched forward pass about 1.5 times faster. Compared to cuPauliProp on an NVIDIA A100, PADO-Pauli evaluates up to 10 times faster on 4 to 12 qubits and uses up to 3.1 times less memory on 16 qubits. We check its accuracy against exact statevector simulation up to 28 qubits. These features make PADO-Pauli a practical toolkit for training variational quantum algorithms, including quantum machine learning models.
summary:
1. 该工作提出 PADO-Pauli，一个 GPU 加速的 Pauli 传播引擎，将变分量子电路及其可观测量一次性编译为稀疏矩阵，后续参数与数据批次求值仅需复用含余弦、正弦因子的编译程序。
2. 其技术卖点在于梯度默认来自注册至 PyTorch 自动微分的向量-雅可比积，可穿透角度流入任意经典层，并支持 Pauli 权重与系数截断、噪声通道和零滤波；在 A100 上相比 cuPauliProp，4 至 12 量子比特求值最高快 10 倍，16 量子比特显存最多省 3.1 倍，零滤波使批前向约快 1.5 倍。
3. 该引擎在至多 28 量子比特上与精确态矢量模拟核对精度，为训练变分量子算法和量子机器学习模型提供了实用且可扩展的经典辅助路径。

title: A Tutorial on Quantum Amplitude Embedding with Data Re-Uploading
abstract: Amplitude embedding lets a variational quantum model read many classical features with few qubits, but the model output is then only a quadratic form in the normalized input. Data re-uploading, which encodes the input repeatedly between trainable blocks, can be used to enrich such a model. Because every additional upload of an amplitude embedding repeats a costly state preparation, the gain that an upload buys has to be known before the gates are spent. This tutorial thus addresses the problem of explaining what data re-uploading adds to an amplitude-embedded model and how large the gain is. We express sequential re-uploading and parallel re-uploading with two copies in one notation and show that each upload raises the reachable polynomial order by two. Under one trainable circuit family and one budget of trainable parameters, simulation results show that re-uploading raises the test coefficient of determination from 0.689 to between 0.883 and 0.975 on targets of order four and from 0.337 to between 0.642 and 0.783 on targets of order six, on all ten seeds. On a quadratic target and on handwritten digits, one upload remains the best choice, and every additional upload lowers the gate error that the classifier tolerates. These results help designers match the number of uploads to the polynomial order of the task at hand.
summary:
1. 该教程系统梳理了量子振幅嵌入中的数据重上传机制，统一描述顺序重上传与双副本并行重上传，并量化每次上传对可表达多项式阶数与预测性能的增益。
2. 其核心结论是每次重上传将可达多项式阶数提高两阶，在相同可训练电路族与参数预算下把四阶目标测试决定系数从0.689提升至0.883至0.975，六阶目标从0.337提升至0.642至0.783，且十个随机种子均成立。
3. 该分析为按任务多项式阶数选择上传次数提供依据，并指出二次目标与手写数字任务中一次上传最优，额外上传会降低分类器可容忍的门误差。

title: Emergent Non-Biorthogonal Born Rule at Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
abstract: Non-Hermitian dynamics possesses distinct left and right eigenstates, but their normalization freedom obscures a direct probabilistic interpretation. Starting from a globally Hermitian system governed by the standard Born rule, we generalize dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) from a reference state to a physical subspace. This generalization provides a clear probabilistic interpretation of left and right states: when each state is normalized to itself, their mutual overlap determines a directly accessible dynamical transition rate. We discuss the new phenomena governed by this emergent non-biorthogonal Born rule and further identify a class of exceptional-point DQPTs (EP-DQPTs), at which the eigenstates of the critical propagator coalesce. Our theory places the probabilistic interpretation of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics on the firm footing of Hermitian quantum mechanics.
summary:
1. 该工作从满足标准Born规则的全局厄米体系出发，将动力学量子相变推广到物理子空间，并导出涌现的非双正交Born规则。
2. 其要点是左右本征态各自归一后，二者交叠给出可直接获取的转变率，并识别出临界传播子本征态合并的例外点DQPT。
3. 这为在厄米量子力学框架下诠释非厄米量子力学提供了坚实基础，并启示相关非厄米动力学与相变的研究。

title: Ergotropy of multipartite entangled states in the quantum atmosphere
