abstract: We investigate the ergotropy of tripartite Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) and W states in the quantum atmosphere of a Schwarzschild black hole, focusing on how the extractable work is redistributed under Hawking-induced thermalization. We find that the two classes of multipartite entanglement exhibit qualitatively different ergotropy structures. For GHZ states, the ergotropies associated with different accessible subsystems organize into two degenerate families, whereas for W states they obey a linear averaging relation with no counterpart in the GHZ case. Under symmetric gravitational thermal corrections, the two GHZ families remain separated by a constant energy gap that is independent of the radial position. We further show that the Hartle-Hawking constant $D_{HH}$ and the normalized radial distance $r/r_h$ play competing roles in the evolution of extractable work: increasing $D_{HH}$ suppresses its recovery toward the asymptotic Hawking limit, while increasing $r/r_h$ enhances the ergotropy accessible to the observers. These results show that the redistribution of extractable work in a black-hole environment is governed not only by gravitationally induced thermalization but also by the structure of the underlying multipartite entanglement, providing a thermodynamic signature that distinguishes GHZ- and W-type quantum correlations in curved spacetime.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了Schwarzschild黑洞量子大气中三体GHZ态与W态的ergotropy，考察Hawking热化下可提取功的重分配。
2. 关键在于GHZ与W态的ergotropy结构定性不同：前者分属两简并族、能隙与径向位置无关，后者服从线性平均；D_HH与r/r_h则相互竞争。
3. 该结果表明黑洞环境中可提取功的重分配不仅受引力诱导热化的支配，也取决于多体纠缠结构，可作为弯曲时空中区分GHZ型与W型量子关联的热力学特征。

title: Distance Prediction for Quantum Codes
abstract: The distance of a quantum code is a fundamental metric that dictates its error-correction capability. While quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) families such as Bivariate Bicycle (BB) codes offer a promising pathway to low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computing, computing their distance is challenging. Current exact solvers and even search heuristics that provide a distance upper bound suffer from severe computational bottlenecks, restricting the discovery of optimal codes. In this paper, we construct a dataset of BB codes with corresponding distance upper bounds obtained through high-budget heuristic searches. We introduce BB-Net, an attention-based neural network architecture for predicting the distance of BB codes. It achieves 96.39% accuracy on the reference distances in the test set, compared with 94.86% for state-of-the-art heuristics with a budget of up to $10^{4}$ times more computational runtime. On a subset with certified exact distances, BB-Net achieves 98.94%. By relieving the distance-calculation bottleneck, BB-Net enables faster screening of large code spaces, particularly in ML-driven search pipelines, and thereby can accelerate the discovery of novel quantum error-correcting codes, an important capability for advancing scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. Our code is publicly available: this https URL
summary:
1. 该工作构建了含高预算启发式搜索所得距离上界的二元自行车（BB）码数据集，并提出基于注意力神经网络的BB-Net，用于直接预测BB码的码距。
2. 其核心卖点在于：在测试集参考距离上准确率达96.39%，优于运算预算高出至多10^4倍的最先进启发式方法的94.86%，并在具有认证精确码距的子集上达到98.94%。
3. 该方法缓解了码距计算的瓶颈，可加速大码空间筛选，尤其在机器学习驱动的搜索流程中，有望加快新型量子纠错码的发现，从而推动可扩展容错量子计算。

title: Methods for Automated Equivalence Checking of Quantum Error-Correction Codes
abstract: Quantum error-correction code and circuit construction is an active field of research, motivating automated methods for identifying equivalent designs. We develop and evaluate automated strategies for deciding whether two descriptions of quantum error-correction codes are equivalent under specified transformations. We formalize permutation equivalence for stabilizer and CSS codes and local-Clifford equivalence for stabilizer codes within a unified framework that separates physical from representation freedom. We develop three decision strategies (group-action search, isomorphism-based methods, and constraint solving), together with invariants and signatures for preprocessing. The empirical evaluation shows that no paradigm dominates across equivalence notions, code families, and parameter ranges. We therefore combine their complementary strengths in input-dependent hybrid checkers following a staged Refute-Refine-Decide architecture. Mean hybrid runtimes remain below 10 s for most evaluated structured-code cases with $n \leq 37$; for inequivalent code instances with $n=144$, they are about 310 s for permutation and 16 s for local-Clifford equivalence.
summary:
1. 该工作为量子纠错码的自动等价性判定提出统一框架，形式化了 stabilizer 与 CSS 码的置换等价及 stabilizer 码的局部 Clifford 等价，并区分物理自由度与表示自由度。
2. 其技术卖点在于比较群作用搜索、同构方法与约束求解三种策略并辅以不变量与签名预处理，证明无单一范式占优，遂按输入组合为分阶段 Refute-Refine-Decide 的混合判定器。
3. 该混合方法在 n≤37 的结构化码上平均运行时间多低于 10 秒，在 n=144 的非等价实例上置换与局部 Clifford 判定分别约 310 秒与 16 秒，可用于码与线路设计的自动化流程。

title: V-type Atomic Variance Squeezing
abstract: Variance squeezing of a V-type atom interacting with a dissipative cavity is investigated. First, the influence of atomic initial state parameters on the variance squeezing is explored. The results show that the atomic variance squeezing switches alternately between Sx and Sy as the initial state parameter alpha sweeps from -pi to pi. The two squeezing intervals are symmetric about alpha = pi/4, each with a width of pi/2. For alpha = pi/14, only the Sx component can generate variance squeezing and will eventually disappear with time evolution due to unavoidable environmental noise. Then, the influence of system parameters on the variance squeezing is also studied. It is found that, the optical variance squeezing depth of Sx is determined solely by the atomic initial parameters and is independent of the system parameters. Both weak cavity-environment coupling and atom-cavity detuning can significantly enhance the robustness of the Sx variance squeezing. The SGI parameter has an extremely weak influence on variance squeezing. These results are beneficial for high-precision quantum communication applications.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了耗散腔中V型原子与腔场相互作用下的方差压缩，考察了原子初态参数与系统参数的影响。
2. 发现Sx与Sy压缩随初态相位α交替出现且关于α=π/4对称、各宽π/2，且Sx压缩深度仅由原子初态决定而与系统参数无关。
3. 弱腔-环境耦合与原子-腔失谐可显著增强Sx压缩鲁棒性，SGI参数影响极弱，这有利于高精度量子通信应用。

title: Unequal Coherent Ergotropy at Equal Interferometric Visibility and Energy in Quantum-Controlled Interferometers
abstract: The ergotropy, or unitarily extractable work, of a quantum system naturally splits into incoherent and coherent contributions, respectively set by population inversion and coherences in the energy eigenbasis. We show that this split makes the coherent ergotropy of a Mach--Zehnder qubit sensitive to path predictability that the output interference fringes do not reveal. We send the path qubit, prepared as a thermal quantum battery, through two quantum-controlled interferometers built from the same elements, a fixed beam splitter and a beam splitter coherently controlled to be present or absent, differing only in the order in which these two act. The two arrangements share identical visibility, stored energy, and incoherent ergotropy at every point in the parameter space. Yet, for work extracted from the output battery alone, placing the controlled beam splitter first never yields less coherent ergotropy, and at fixed visibility and interferometric phase the difference is governed by the path predictability that this ordering creates. The same expression reappears as a purity deficit on the beam-splitter controller, so the work advantage comes with a Landauer bound on the cost of locally resetting the controller that is never larger at the same temperature. We further examine the effects of decoherence on the battery and consider a relativistic realization in which a Wigner rotation correlates the particle's spin with its path. Tracing out the spin decoheres the battery and allows the two arrangements to exhibit different coherent ergotropies even in regimes where their non-relativistic counterparts coincide. These results show that interference visibility is not a complete measure of the coherence available as work.
summary:
1. 该工作比较了仅分束器作用顺序不同的两个量子控制干涉仪中热量子电池的相干可提取功。
2. 在可见度、储能与非相干功完全相同时，相干功仍取决于路径可预测性，且控制分束器在前的顺序不会给出更低值，并对应控制器纯度亏损及同温下不更大的Landauer复位代价。
3. 电池退相干与相对论Wigner旋转（自旋—路径关联）可进一步区分两排列，表明干涉可见度并非可用功相干性的完备度量。

title: Experimental Realization of a C-Shunt Flux-Qubit Coupler for Controlled-Z Gates between Transmons
abstract: Fast entangling gates and low-interaction idling require distinct operating conditions in superconducting quantum processors. We experimentally realize a transmon-C-shunt-transmon (TCT) device in which a flux-tunable, three-junction capacitively shunted flux-qubit coupler connects two transmon data qubits. The C-shunt coupler provides a flux-tunable, positively anharmonic spectrum for tailoring the interactions between the data qubits. Conditional Ramsey and swap measurements identify an idle region with near-zero residual ZZ interaction strength and suppressed transverse exchange. At this bias, simultaneous single-qubit interleaved randomized benchmarking yields X-gate fldelities above 99.7%, consistent with individual operation. A 45 ns nonadiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gate achieves an interleaved randomized benchmarking fldelity estimate of 99.23(15)%. Numerical simulations identify coupler energy relaxation as an important limitation on CZ-gate fldelity and indicate that extending the coupler lifetime can improve gate performance. These results demonstrate the experimental feasibility of C-shunt flux-qubit couplers for combining low-interaction idling with fast entangling operations between transmon qubits.
summary:
1. 该工作实验实现了由磁通可调的三结电容分流通量比特耦合器连接两个传输子数据比特的器件，并测量其闲置区域与门操作。
2. 核心卖点是该耦合器具有可调正非谐谱，可在近零残余 Z-Z 相互作用且横向交换被抑制的偏置点闲置，同时单比特交织随机基准保真度超过 99.7%，45 纳秒非绝热受控 Z 门保真度估计为 99.23(15)%。
3. 数值模拟指出耦合器能量弛豫是受控 Z 门保真度的重要限制，延长耦合器寿命可提升性能，这证明电容分流通量比特耦合器有望兼顾低相互作用闲置与快速纠缠，为超导量子处理器设计提供实验依据。

title: On the Increase of Boltzmann Entropy in Closed Macroscopic Quantum Systems
abstract:
We consider a closed macroscopic quantum system in a pure state $\psi$ evolving unitarily with Hamiltonian $H$ in a finite-dimensional Hilbert space $\mathscr{H}$. Following von Neumann, we assume a decomposition of $\mathscr{H}$ into mutually orthogonal subspaces $\mathscr{H}_{
u}$, where each $
u$ represents a macro state, and $\mathscr{H}_
u$ contains the pure states compatible with $
u$. We define the quantum Boltzmann entropy for a macro state $
u$ as $S_\mathrm{qB}(
u) = k_{\mathrm{B}} \log \dim \mathscr{H}_{
u}$, where $k_\mathrm{B}$ is the Boltzmann constant. Goldstein et al. [ http://arxiv.org/abs/1903.11870 ] have suggested, as a version of the second law of thermodynamics, that $S_\mathrm{qB}$ predominantly increases with time for realistic macroscopic systems. Here, we discuss precise versions of this statement and confirm them for several simple models of $H$ and $\mathscr{H}_
u$.
summary:
1. 该工作研究有限维希尔伯特空间中纯态在哈密顿量 H 下幺正演化的封闭宏观量子系统，沿用 von Neumann 将空间分解为相互正交宏观态子空间 H_ν 的方案，并把与宏观态 ν 相容的纯态归入 H_ν，进而定义量子玻尔兹曼熵 S_qB(ν)=k_B log dim H_ν。
2. 其核心贡献在于将 Goldstein 等人提出的“S_qB 对现实宏观系统主要随时间增加”这一第二定律式论断细化为精确命题，并在若干简单 H 与 H_ν 模型上确认其成立，而非仅停留于启发式论证。
3. 这为从纯态幺正演化理解宏观热力学箭头提供了可检验框架，并提示后续需在更现实的哈密顿量与更一般的宏观态分解下检验该熵增陈述的适用范围与稳健性。

title: $T$-efficient unitary synthesis via block-sparse Hamiltonian simulation
abstract: We construct Clifford+$T$ circuits implementing arbitrary $n$-qubit unitaries with worst-case $T$-count $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7})$ at constant operator-norm error, where $N=2^n$, improving the previous exponent $5/4$. The construction uses $\widetilde{O}(N^{6/7})$ clean ancillas. The main idea is to reduce the data addressed by each query to the block-encoding circuit for a sparse piece while controlling the additional simulation work needed to combine the pieces. We simulate a Hermitian logarithm of the target by flattening its traceless part with a two-layer random similarity transformation, randomly partitioning the transformed generator into block-sparse Hermitian pieces, and combining their evolutions using qDRIFT. For a target operator-norm error $\epsilon\in(0,1/2)$, let $L=\log_2(N/\epsilon)$, the qubit count plus the requested bits of accuracy. By successively correcting the approximation error, we obtain a circuit using $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7}L^{3/7}+NL)$ $T$ gates and $\widetilde{O}(N)$ clean ancillas whenever $L\le N$. We also prove that, at constant precision, the exponent $8/7$ is optimal within a sequential block-SELECT model.
summary:
1. 该工作构造Clifford+T电路，以最坏情况T门数Õ(N^{8/7})实现任意n量子比特幺正，将常数算符范数误差下指数从5/4降至8/7。
2. 其核心在于将目标的厄米对数经两层随机相似变换压平无迹部分，随机分块为稀疏厄米块，并用qDRIFT组合演化以降低单次查询数据量。
3. 该结果在常数精度下证明8/7指数于顺序块SELECT模型中最优，并启示分块稀疏模拟可改进通用幺正合成的T门代价。

title: Finite-energy two-way assisted capacities: Exact formulas for multimode loss and fading
abstract: We study quantum communication, entanglement distribution, and secret-key generation through multimode bosonic loss and fading channels, assisted by local quantum operations and two-way classical communication. Using sector teleportation, we determine the exact two-way quantum and secret-key capacities of multimode pure-loss channels under a mean photon-number constraint, allowing arbitrary adaptive quantum protocols. We extend these results to continuous frequency-dependent loss under a power constraint and identify the optimal allocation of photons among optical modes. For constant loss over an unlimited bandwidth, we obtain a closed-form capacity proportional to the square root of power. For randomly varying loss, we determine exact finite-energy capacities when the channel realization is publicly revealed, distinguishing knowledge before and after transmission. When fading remains unobserved, we derive capacity bounds and explicit formulas for an on/off channel. We also establish strong-converse bounds, with exact thresholds for the deterministic loss models considered here, observed fading, and unobserved fading with finitely many possible transmissivities. Under mean energy constraints, these thresholds generally exceed the corresponding finite-energy capacities. These results guide energy allocation and provide benchmarks for energy-constrained optical quantum communication with multimode signals and variable loss.
summary:
1. 该工作利用扇区隐形传态，在平均光子数或功率约束下，确定了多模玻色纯损耗与衰落信道中双向经典通信辅助的量子与密钥容量的精确公式。
2. 其卖点是将任意自适应协议纳入统一框架，给出频率相关损耗的最优光子分配、无限带宽恒定损耗容量随功率平方根增长的闭式解，以及衰落公开或未观测时的精确容量或界与强逆阈值。
3. 这些结果可指导能量约束下的光子模式分配，并为多模光量子通信、纠缠分发和密钥生成在可变损耗环境中的协议设计与基准测试提供明确启示。

title: Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
abstract: Massive mechanical oscillators couple directly to forces, accelerations and gravity, making them attractive probes of new physics and of quantum mechanics at macroscopic scales. Pushing sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit for signals of unknown phase requires non-Gaussian quantum states, whose metrological advantage has so far been confined to lighter systems such as trapped ions. Here we operate a microgram-scale acoustic mode of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator as a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced sensor. A transmon qubit prepares the mode in Fock states of up to seven phonons by optimal control, and resolves its phonon-number distribution after interaction with a weak resonant signal. Bayesian analysis yields a Fisher information five times the vacuum value, a 7.0 dB gain in signal-amplitude sensitivity over any classical probe state, irrespective of its energy, currently limited by state preparation infidelities. We then train a neural network on the measured sensor response to perform Bayesian estimation without any analytical model of the system, showing the same sensitivity gain with half the systematic bias. Our results establish acoustic resonators prepared in non-Gaussian states as quantum-enhanced probes for high-frequency gravitational waves, dark matter and wave-function collapse.
summary:
1. 该工作将高次泛音体声波谐振器中微克级声学模式用作相位不敏感量子增强传感器，利用传输子量子比特经最优控制制备至多七个声子的福克态，并在弱共振信号作用后读取其声子数分布。
2. 其主要卖点是贝叶斯分析得到五倍于真空态的费舍尔信息，以及对任意能量经典探测态7.0分贝的振幅灵敏度增益，当前受态制备非理想性限制；并训练神经网络从实测传感响应中无解析模型地执行贝叶斯估计，以一半系统偏差保持相同增益。
3. 这确立了非高斯态声学谐振器作为高频引力波、暗物质与波函数坍缩探测的量子增强探针。

title: $\mathsf{EFI}\Leftrightarrow\mathsf{1PRS}$
abstract: A series of recent works has established EFI pairs as the "minimal" assumption for quantum cryptography. Recently, Cavalar et al. [CCC+26] showed that EFI pairs are equivalent to non-uniform expanding single-copy pseudorandom state generators (1PRS), and obtained a non-uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. We remove the non-uniformity in their construction and prove that EFI pairs are equivalent to expanding 1PRS. As a corollary, we obtain the first uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. Together with the equivalence of statistically verifiable one-way state generators and commitments proved by Batra and Jain [BJ24], this gives a quantum analogue of the classical equivalence between one-way functions, commitments, and pseudorandom generators.
summary:
1. 该工作证明EFI对与可扩展的单副本伪随机态生成器（1PRS）等价，去除了Cavalar等人构造中的非一致性。
2. 其卖点在于给出EFI对的首个一致性元复杂性刻画，并由此得到单向函数、承诺与伪随机生成器经典等价关系的量子类比。
3. 这提示EFI对可统一支撑量子密码学的多项基本原语，为刻画其最小假设提供了明确的归约框架。

title: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
abstract: It is proved that every Borel ensemble of pure states on a separable bipartite Hilbert space with finite average entanglement admits a countable ensemble with the same barycenter and arbitrarily small additional average entanglement. Consequently, the discrete and continuous versions of the Entanglement of Formation coincide on the whole space of states of infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system (with infinite values allowed). The main idea of the proof (realized with the AI-assistance) is the identification of a Borel ensemble of pure bipartite states with a Borel probability measure on the unit sphere of the space of Hilbert--Schmidt operators followed by dividing the support of this measure into appropriate cells and replacing each cell by its conditional barycenter. The resulting countable ensemble is obtained by a recursive construction.
summary:
1. 该工作证明可分二体希尔伯特空间上任意平均纠缠有限的博雷尔纯态系综，都可用可数系综以相同重心和任意小额外平均纠缠逼近。
2. 其核心技巧是把二体纯态系综对应为希尔伯特-施密特算子单位球上的博雷尔概率测度，再将支集分格并递归替换为条件重心。
3. 这使纠缠形成的离散与连续定义在允许无限值的无限维二体系统全态空间上重合，并为连续纠缠度量提供可数逼近构造思路。

title: Gaussian entanglement and quantum communication: geodesic optimization and multimode bounds
abstract: Loss and noise limit the use of light to distribute entanglement, transmit quantum information, and establish secret keys. Gaussian states have a compact description in terms of means and covariance matrices, but their entanglement still requires global optimization. We develop a framework for computing Gaussian-restricted versions of the relative entropy of entanglement and Rains entanglement. An integral representation reveals a convex geometry under matrix geometric means and reduces Gaussian Rains entanglement to relative entropy minimized over Gaussian states with positive partial transpose. We obtain unique optimal reference states and additivity for independent Gaussian input states. Our convex-majorization algorithm has an explicit geometric convergence rate, uniform in the faithful regularization parameter and valid for pure input states. Controlled numerical integration and approximate convex subproblem solutions give a bit-complexity bound that is polynomial in accuracy bits for each fixed rational input covariance matrix, with explicit dependence on covariance size. These calculations bound extractable entanglement and, through the relative entropy of entanglement, extractable secret key. Teleportation simulation, energy allocation, and a convex optimization of passive-basis loss cores give bounds on quantum and private communication under an input-energy constraint, allowing arbitrary two-way classically assisted protocols. Two- and three-mode examples compare the bounds with achievable rates, including matching pure-loss benchmarks. Finally, we separate the Gaussian-restricted quantities from their unrestricted counterparts and give a photon-number truncation method with controlled error for computing the latter.
summary:
1. 该工作提出了计算高斯限制下相对熵纠缠与Rains纠缠的框架，用积分表示揭示矩阵几何平均下的凸几何，并将高斯Rains纠缠归约为正部分转置高斯态间的相对熵最小化。
2. 其卖点是获得唯一最优参考态与独立高斯输入的可加性，凸主化算法具显式几何收敛率，且对固定有理协方差矩阵给出精度比特多项式复杂度，并界定可提取纠缠、密钥以及能量约束下量子与私密通信的界。
3. 这为有损噪声下的多模量子通信提供可计算界，并将高斯限制量与无限制量分离，配合可控误差的光子数截断方法，可启发协议基准比较与实验速率评估。
